behavior: Display-refresh macro (DLP trampoline, src @0x627ac; name is misleading): if annotation (ANNOT) is on it calls __AMDISP to repaint the amplitude/annotation display, otherwise CLRDSP clears the screen and re-enables the graticule (GRAT ON) when GRAT is set.

name: PKPOS
behavior: Native handler at 0x4264e: computes a peak/marker trace-point position via jsr $32c22, clamps it to max 0x400 (1024 points), reads counter longword $421a8, and runs marker positioning math through jsr $64f0/$6444 — positions/returns the marker at a trace index.

name: PLOT
behavior: Native HP-GL plotter-output dispatcher at 0x4062e: an entry-point table sets a plot sub-mode code in D1 (values -6..+6) then jmps to the shared plot routine $3e702, popping A0/A1 (pen/coord args) and pushing return callback $4068a.

name: PP
behavior: Softkey-definition macro (DLP trampoline, src @0x6989ca): defines the 'TRIG MKR' (trigger-marker) ON/OFF toggle softkey (KH .../|ON .OFF.) bound to handler __GTTMF.

name: PREAMPG
behavior: Unresolved (handler pc=0, not reachable via the dispatch tables); by name and arg-type 0x1D a preamplifier-gain command — sets/queries the RF preamp gain offset (dB) applied as an amplitude correction. Best-effort, unverified.

name: PREFX
behavior: FFT-mode menu setup (DLP trampoline, src @0x63790): calls __FFTPAMK then KEYDEFs the FFT softkeys — key 131→__FFAPC 'ANALOG+ ON/OFF', keys 61/67→FFTMM 'MARKER MID SCRN', 8044→__FFSSHKC, 8041→__FFMUHKC.

name: PRINT
behavior: Native hardcopy-PRINT setup at 0x4f634: validates the output-device selector (both the arg in D0 and the 2nd arg at (8,A6) must be 0..3, else forced to the 0xffff sentinel) and reads the per-device config byte table at (-$61ae,A4), masking the low 3 bits — selects/configures the print output device.

name: PRNTPPG
behavior: Native handler at 0x2e2ae: reads plot/print state word $ab7c.w and, based on bit 9 of mode flag $ab76.w, dispatches to one of two output routines ($2e216 or $2e0d2) — drives a print/plot page output.

name: PRSDAC2
behavior: Unresolved (handler pc=0, not reachable via the dispatch tables); by name and arg-type 0x05 a service/diagnostic 'preset DAC 2' — forces a preset code onto analog DAC #2 on the A7 analog-control bus. Best-effort, unverified.

name: PSTATE
behavior: Unresolved (handler pc=0, not reachable via the dispatch tables); by name and arg-type 0x0F a state-protection command — most likely protects the saved instrument-state registers from being overwritten. Best-effort, unverified.

name: PURGE
behavior: Native catalog-delete at 0x3c4d2: deletes a user file from the save/recall catalog by indexing 0x22-byte records based at (-$5c54,A4) with file index $a35c.w, iterating via $3a374 with callback $3d108 and clearing the selected entry.

name: PURGES
behavior: Native handler at 0x5f1cc in the DLP-runtime region: bsr $5eca2 yields a status bit0 that selects among management routines $5e84a/$5e6bc/$5e364; the exact object purged is not resolvable from the flag-gated dispatch alone.

name: PURGET
behavior: Marker/window housekeeping macro (DLP trampoline, src @0x6fdbe): reads WINSTAT/WINZOOM into __Q, and when annotation is on it walks marker-state fields (MSFIELD 37..48) and redraws peak markers via __PKBMD/__PKMBD/__PKDMD (with __PKNSP/__PKNAU unit fix-ups).

name: PWRBW
behavior: FFT power-bandwidth measurement (DLP trampoline, src @0x654b4): runs PEAKS on the trace, computes the dB offset of the found peak vs PKPOS ((TRB[__L]-TRB[PKPOS])/100) into the percent-amplitude marker FFTPCTAMR, scales it x200, and calls __FFTAMD to display it.

name: PWRSD
behavior: DLP power-up macro: runs DLPINIT and __AMTERM, sets __AMRFLG=1, forces MENU 50 when not already active, schedules __SOONRUN, and installs an ONCMD ANNOT handler.

name: PWRUPOB
behavior: Power-up option-board/cal load: validates a cal-RAM block via jsr $61ec (checksum) then copies calibration/config words from cal RAM $2fc016/$2fcb42/$2fc91a/$2fca1c into low-RAM working buffers $9eb6/$a01e/$a096/$a198, gated by a version compare (#$218f vs $bfee).

name: PWRUPTIME
behavior: DLP macro that clamps the graph time-marker variable __GTDMKR into the range [1E-6, 65E-3] at power-up.

name: QPGAIN
behavior: Sets an analog gain: clamps the arg via jsr $7978 (max 0xff), stores it to $9ecd and a 4-entry byte table, then merges the low byte into shadow $b204 and writes it to MMIO control/gain port 0xFFF712.

name: QPOFFSETL
behavior: Handler did not resolve via the dispatch tables (pc=0); by name it appears to set/query a quasi-peak-detector offset (low band) for EMI measurements.

name: QPRST
behavior: Reset routine: if $b0e6>0 it aborts via jsr $2bc, else saves $b05e->$b05c and $bf02, clears the local frame and $bf0a, and (when b05c==4 && $9b20==3) drives HP-IB/serial MMIO $f100/$f130/$f148/$f160 before reading status via jsr $54d78.

name: RCLT
behavior: Short getter that reads and returns the 16-bit RAM word at $b20a.

name: RCTITLE
behavior: DLP macro: if __Z==1 clears the box (CLRBOX 1,1,399,199,0), activates window __X, sets __GTSPF=0, then HD;NV to redraw the title/window.

name: RDBCDL
behavior: DLP macro: sets __GTPFLG=1, sets marker __GGTMN=248, runs __GTWINTRK window tracking, and (if __Z==1) sets coordinate vars __A/__B/__C to 180/170/160.

name: RDDBL
behavior: DLP macro that runs the object-window setup macros __OBWS and __OBWM then NV.

name: RDREAL
dlp_source: HD;AMSG'You must press FFT OFF  to use this feature';
behavior: DLP macro that displays the alarm message "You must press FFT OFF to use this feature" (HD;AMSG...), rejecting the command while FFT mode is active.

name: REFF
behavior: Resolves to fcn.34EE8, the DLP command-interpreter/parser step: reads the parser control block (A0 at -4,A6), tests $a89f bit5, walks the in/out pointers at (14,A4)/(16,A4), fetches characters via jsr $4258 and handles '?' (query) and space tokens.

name: RELHPIB
behavior: Short handler: stores the arg to RAM $ba58, loads $b076, and calls fcn.80a0 (the reference-level/amplitude-scaling recompute); despite the name the disasm shows a $ba58 write plus a scaling recompute, not an HP-IB bus release.

name: REPEAT
behavior: Small guard at 0x406ec (shared with RETURN): tests $b1e0 bit 12 and $b1fe==0x12 and, only if both hold, does jsr $4d8, else rts; two command names map to this one PC with different arg types so which name it truly serves is unresolved.

name: RESETRL
behavior: Handler at 0x5ecb6 reads/returns the RAM word $94de (reference-level/ADC-cal state); the adjacent routine at 0x5ecbc performs the actual reset (clears $94de/$94e0/$94d6 and polls sweep-status $f300 bit 11).

name: RETURN
behavior: Same handler PC as REPEAT (0x406ec): tests $b1e0 bit 12 / $b1fe==0x12 then conditionally jsr $4d8; the shared PC means the RETURN name-to-behavior mapping is ambiguous.

name: REV
behavior: NOT a firmware-revision query: dispatches on bsr $274d4 and outputs memory-card/file status strings from ROM ($2b482 "CARD:"/"NO CARD"/"BAD MEDIA", $2b4ba "Purge complete", $2b4ca "TYPE"/"NOT FOUND"/"FILENAME:") via jsr $22c/$2da.

name: REVW
behavior: Packs a scaled value: divides the arg by 10 up to 3x (while >1) to form a 2-bit exponent, ORs it into $b0f0 low bits, then clamps two more params via jsr $7978 into $b0f2 and $b0f4 and calls fcn.5dea8.

name: RFCAT
behavior: Trampoline running DLP macro `KH /SWEEP|DELAY/,ACTVF __GTSWDE,0;NV`: installs a key-hook that matches the SWEEP/DELAY keys and sets the active-function display via the __GTSWDE (sweep-delay) getter.

name: RMS
behavior: Trampoline DLP macro `TRPRST;DISPOSE ONMKRU;IF(ACPPAR)...ELSE DISPOSE ONEOS`: resets traps, disposes the marker-update (ONMKRU) handler, then branches on ACP mode — running __ACPRCLP + LIMITEST0 when ACP params are active, else disposing the end-of-sweep handler. A measurement/detector setup macro.

name: RQS
behavior: Native handler at 0x4F8B4 parses an optional numeric argument (via $6e8/$6090) and defaults to the current mask word at $9EA6.w when none is given, then dispatches through $4E8AE; acts as the GPIB Request-Service (SRQ) mask set/query.

name: SADD
behavior: Native routine at 0xC470 runs a 7-iteration init loop (i=0..6) copying words from the ROM table at $B30E into RAM words based at ~$FFBA96 (disp -$456A) and zeroing companion words at ~$FFBAA4 (disp -$455C); a table/state reset that ignores the passed argument.

name: SAVEMENU
behavior: Native handler at 0x30EAC validates via $306DA then, per the argument's bit0, sets ($30EC2) or clears ($30ECA) bit 12 of the menu/display flag word $B0D6.w and applies the change via $30E00; an on/off menu-save toggle.

name: SAVET
behavior: Native handler at 0x3D3B0 emits a "#A"-prefixed (0x2341) length-tagged binary block over HP-IB — writes the header, a count, then each data byte via output routines $7108/$73FE/$7068; the companion function at 0x3D3EE parses the same '#','A' header on input. Save/recall-trace block I/O.

name: SAVRCLTR
behavior: Native handler at 0x26512 works on the 16-byte structure at $AC5C: if the arg is '?' it outputs a query via $2639C, else stores via $26416 and mirrors bit0 of $AC6B into $AC5B; then refreshes the user softkey menu from $956A via $92E. Save/recall-trace register handler.

name: SDEL
behavior: Trampoline DLP macro `IF(ACTVF(MKPAUSE));MKPAUSE0;ELSE;MKPAUSE1`: toggles marker pause — issues MKPAUSE0 (off) when MKPAUSE is the active function, otherwise MKPAUSE1 (on).

name: SEDIF
behavior: Handler did not resolve through the dispatch tables (pc=0); a tag-0x40 typed command with arg-type 0x16. Name plausibly denotes a 'set difference/delta' or sweep-segment parameter, but no disassembly is available to confirm.

name: SEGDEL
behavior: Trampoline DLP macro that, when __V==__X, renumbers the active menu variable __GGTMN (243->242, 246->...) and calls __GTMAP to remap; a segment-delete that renumbers/remaps a segmented (limit-line/sweep-segment) table menu.

name: SELP
behavior: Trampoline DLP macro `IF(__PZKP==0){__PZKP=1;}PKZOOM;ELSE MOV PKZOOM,PKZOOM`: if the __PZKP guard flag is clear it sets it and invokes PKZOOM (peak zoom), otherwise a no-op; arms/latches the peak-zoom action.

name: SENTER
behavior: Native handler at 0x3B330 is a thin wrapper: it pushes the argument and calls the shared parameter-entry routine $3B27E with selector D0=0x0D (13); sibling entries nearby call the same routine with selectors 0x0A/1/9/3.

name: SENTERT
behavior: Native handler at 0x179FE is `bsr $179E2;rts`: it clears bit 11 of mode word $B212.w, calls $179CC, and if $BA6B bit2 is clear ORs #$56 into the status word $B1F8.w, then calls the update routine $19C; a mode/state toggle with status-bit set.

name: SER
behavior: Trampoline DLP macro `IF(1==__FFTSTF);MOV FFTSTOP,MF;ENDIF;NV`: when the FFT-stop flag __FFTSTF is set, copies FFTSTOP into MF (marker frequency); FFT stop-frequency handling.

name: SERSET
behavior: Native handler at 0x550D0 parses a user array argument (count/pointer via $2F2) and, when a status bit from $54EF6 is set, iterates the array writing each word via $54EB2 (bounded by the arg count at (8,A6)) and finalizes via $54F6E; loads a block of values into a subsystem.

name: SETPLL
behavior: Native handler at 0x11A22 computes a PLL tuning word (sign-dependent path via $1D8/$2B0 plus scale routine $7978), writes it to $B0E8.w, and clamps the value against the min/max bounds passed as arguments; a synthesizer PLL setting.

name: SETUPCAT
behavior: Trampoline DLP macro installing an ONEOS (end-of-sweep) handler that captures MKF into __GTMKTIME, computes __GTTTM=GD+__GTMKTIME, then pen-up/plot-absolute draws at PA=152; a gated-time ('catalog') marker setup.

name: SFPKEY
behavior: Native getter at 0x5F24C returns the stored softkey-definition longword at $94E8.w when the softkey state $94DA.w != -1 (or when helper checks $5ECA2/$5F0C4 pass), else 0; reads the current soft-front-panel-key definition.

name: SHOWOPT
behavior: DLP-source macro that, only when ANNOT!=0, lifts the pen, positions to PA=288/161 and draws a CSP annotation text label (then captures __Y=ACPSP into __Z). It renders the option/annotation text overlay on the display.

name: SIN
behavior: DLP-source macro that runs __ACPCC and returns on ACPERR, then copies trace B into trace A (MOV TRB,TRA) and derives a __CZAT value from MSBIT(8,9), re-asserting AT and RL. It is an adjacent-channel-power/trace-math macro (name does not correspond to a trig sine); source is truncated at ~80 chars.

name: SMOOTH
behavior: DLP-source macro whose visible preamble only VARDEFs its working variables (TOIR=-100, __TOIRFLG=0, NDBPNTR=-100, __NDBS=-3, ...) for a trace-smoothing routine; the actual smoothing computation is past the 80-char source truncation.

name: SNGLS
behavior: Single-sweep command: tests sweep-mode word $b0e6.w, clears bits 13-14 of sweep-control word $ab76.w (andi #$9fff), calls arm/status helpers fcn.2bb16/2b8f8/2b916, and sets bit 4 of $ab77.w to select single-sweep mode.

name: SPEAKER
behavior: Takes two 16-bit args (at A6+8 and A6+a) and writes them via generic pointer-store helper fcn.3d2de into two consecutive words of a caller-supplied structure (D0=base, offsets +2/+4); it programs a two-word control block (plausibly the beeper/speaker tone parameters), but the disasm reaches no speaker MMIO directly.

name: SPZOOM
behavior: Init loop (7 iterations, D6=6): copies a 7-word ROM table at PC-relative $b30e into RAM at ~0xFFBA96 (dest (-$456a,A4), A4=index*2) and clears the adjacent word at ~0xFFBAA4; it resets a small state array (span-zoom defaults).

name: SQR
behavior: DLP logic primitive: pops an index via fcn.7c0, fetches word at ROM/RAM table (-$4fa0,A4) (A4=index*2) into D6, bit-tests bit number (arg A6+8) with btst/sne, and pushes the 0/1 boolean result via fcn.77e. It returns a single bit's state, not a square/square-root.

name: SRCALCRf
behavior: Handler did not resolve via the dispatch tables (pc=0); by name it is a tracking-generator source ALC (automatic-level-control) reference/mode setting, arg_type 0xFF. Meaning is a best-effort inference, not confirmed by disasm.

name: SRCNORM
behavior: Handler did not resolve via the dispatch tables (pc=0); by name it is the tracking-generator source-normalization command (store/subtract a reference trace), arg_type 0xC1. Meaning is a best-effort inference, not confirmed by disasm.

name: SRCTKPK
behavior: Source (tracking-generator) track-peak command: loads the command-token pointer (A6+8,A4), checks (1,A4)==0x3f for the '?' query form, and on either path pushes constant #$7000 and calls fcn.3a308/fcn.32bda to perform the tracking-peak operation/readback.

name: SRQ
behavior: GPIB service-request command: range-checks state word $bfee.w against 0x218d..0x2195 (branches to $4b71e when out of range) then falls through to the SRQ handler at $4b532 which sets/manipulates the service-request status.

name: STB
behavior: Status-byte query: loads command-token ptr (-4,A6,A4), tests (1,A4)==0x3f for '?', and on the query path reads the status longword pair from $ac54.w (movem.l into D0-D1) and formats/outputs it via fcn.5762/7190/70d2.

name: STBLUg
behavior: Handler did not resolve via the dispatch tables (pc=0), arg_type 0xFF; name is opaque (possibly a status-byte or internal 'stable' flag helper). No disasm or doc support — meaning unknown.

name: STDEV
behavior: DLP-source macro that reads window status (MOV __Q,WINSTAT WINZOOM) and branches on zoom state: if zoomed runs __J0, else runs peak-integrate __PKITG and, depending on the peak table (PKTBL) / marker table (MKTB...), runs __PKDPT — a marker/peak standard-deviation computation.

name: STOR
behavior: DLP-source macro (complete): if GSTAT(1) is true it sets the time-gate control mode to EDGE, otherwise to LEVEL (GATECTL EDGE/LEVEL). It configures gate-control triggering based on gate status bit 1.

name: STORBCDL
behavior: One entry of a store dispatch table: sets type code D1=-5 (moveq #-5), pops A0/A1 (dest/value) off the stack, loads return address A2=$4068a, pushes A0-A2 and jmp's to the common store routine fcn.3e702; it stores a BCD-long-typed value.

name: STORDBL
behavior: Store (double-type) primitive: reads a status/flag word via fcn.2f498, tests its bits and mode word $b116.w (bit 15) plus $b0ec.w, and on an invalid state reports error code 0x32 via fcn.65e before performing the guarded store.

name: STORREAL
behavior: Takes two word args (A6-2 and A6+8), clamps each to the range 0..15 (clr if <0, cap at 0xf), and stores them as bytes at RAM $ba74.w and $ba75.w; it records a clamped index/coordinate pair (name does not clearly denote a real-number store).

name: SU
behavior: Handler links, pushes buffer pointer $bf66 and the 32-bit value from RAM $bb54, then jsr's fcn 0x3752e (a routine that indexes a word table, masks 0xFFF, computes a size into $a5fa). The SU command semantic is not evident from the call.

name: SUB
behavior: Trampoline runs a DLP menu-state macro: cycles menu variable __MN[18] as (__MN[18]%4)+1, calls __PKFMB, then branches on __MN[19]/__MN[20] — a softkey/menu selection handler.

name: SUM
behavior: Trampoline runs the adjacent-channel-power SUM macro: __ACPSUD;__M5;__ACPSUM plus WINITM 17/18/19,0 and __ACPICALC, computing the ACP band-power summation.

name: SUMSQR
behavior: Trampoline runs an FFT scaling/sum-of-squares macro: tests __FFTA, MOV __F,MF, then rescales FFTSTOP and ST via DIV by 200 — FFT-domain math.

name: SWPCPLTh
behavior: Unresolved (handler_pc=0, arg 0xFF); by name SWPCPL = sweep couple, selecting auto vs. manual coupling of sweep time to span/RBW/VBW. Not confirmed in disassembly.

name: SYNCMODE
behavior: Trampoline runs an interpolation macro: __Q=(2*__B-__A+__C)/2, __R=(2*__C-__D+__B)/2, then sets TOIR to the smaller — a 3-point parabolic peak interpolation.

name: T7
behavior: Handler at 0x00ABDE writes ACRTC command 0x0002 to 0xFFF5FC and 0x0180 to the data port 0xFFF5FE (HD63484 Color Control Register = 2-bpp mode), then rts. T7 and T8 share this one tiny display helper, suggesting dispatch mis-resolution rather than a distinct trace handler.

name: T8
behavior: Same handler_pc (0x00ABDE) as T7: writes ACRTC command 0x0002/data 0x0180 to 0xFFF5FC/0xFFF5FE (HD63484 CCR, 2-bpp), then rts. Two different command names resolving to one routine indicates the dispatch table did not distinguish them.

name: TDF
behavior: Unresolved (handler_pc=0); documented HP command TDF = Trace Data Format, selecting the trace-data transfer encoding (B=binary, M=measurement units, P=parameter/real units, A=ASCII). Not confirmed in disassembly.

name: TEXT
behavior: Handler reads a 2-char token argument; the 2nd char 'C'(0x43)/'F'(0x46)/'S'(0x53) selects RAM word $b1ac/$b1aa/$b1b0 and stores a bounded value (0..0xFFF) there — sets a display text-attribute variable.

name: THEN
behavior: Handler at 0x0406EC tests $b1e0 bit12 AND $b1fe==0x12; if both hold it jsr's low-mem vector 0x4d8 (jmp 0x19a72), else rts — a conditional dispatch gate. Shared with TRA; the specific command semantic is not resolvable here.

name: TIMEDATEB
behavior: Unresolved (handler_pc=0); TIMEDATE sets/enables the on-screen real-time-clock date/time display (TIMEDATE ON/OFF, date/time set; RTC at 0xEF40xx, redraw flag bc67.1). Not confirmed in disassembly.

name: TITLE
behavior: Handler at 0x019700 is a 3-instruction getter returning RAM word $bfee in D0. The normal TITLE (set display title string) behavior is absent, so this handler_pc is likely a mis-resolution to a title/display-state accessor.

name: TMri
behavior: Unresolved (handler_pc=0, arg 0xFF); the name is mangled ('TM'+suffix) and its meaning is uncertain — plausibly a trigger-mode or timing token. Not confirmed in disassembly.

name: TNG
behavior: Handler at 0x040384 builds a status byte at (-1,A6) by testing flags: bit4 $b1f7, bit0 $b0a1, bit8 $b1e0, plus bits of $b1f9/$b073 — a tuning/status query that packs hardware-state flags into its return value.

name: TR
behavior: Trampoline runs the DLP macro __GTMAP;__GTLMKR; — regenerates the trace map and the limit/marker overlay (trace-graticule redraw).

name: TRA
behavior: Trace A array variable (DLP token class 0xc0, array ID 7). `TRA?` outputs trace A data (format set by TDF); `MOV TRA,<data>` / `TRA <block>` writes it. Read/write array shared handler slot 0x3F.

name: TRALLOC
behavior: Trampoline runs a trace-cleanup macro: IF(__CZSU==0) RETURN; else DISPOSE ONEOS, set ACPMK=-1, A1;B4;BLANK TRC — deallocates/blanks a trace object.

name: TRB
behavior: Trace B array variable (DLP token class 0xc0, array ID 8). Read via `TRB?`, write via MOV. Shared array handler slot 0x3F.

name: TRC
behavior: Trace C array variable (DLP token class 0xc0, array ID 9). Shared array handler slot 0x3F.

name: TRCEXP
behavior: At 0x56C82: calls $5687C then loops $B12A.w times, each pass reading a byte from a buffer at (A4-0x4ED6) and calling $56414 (per-element emit/format), finishing with $56C62 and $56096. Iterates over a B12A-length trace element list to expand/output it.

name: TRCLOG
behavior: Trampoline (0x696E2) that pushes the DLP source at ROM 0x696DA and calls the DLP scheduler $D18; the macro is 'MENU 91;' which brings up soft-key menu 91.

name: TRCMEM
behavior: At 0x5B818: indexes a per-trace RAM table via $956C.w*10 (base -0x65EC) and, for arg D0==0xFFFE, fills a 16-byte region at (A4-0x53A4) with 0xFF/0x00 then copies longwords into (A4-0x65AA). Initializes/copies a trace-memory register structure.

name: TRD
behavior: Trace D array variable (DLP token class 0xc0, array ID 10). Shared array handler slot 0x3F.

name: TRDEF
behavior: At 0x40674 loads D1 = 0x0B (operation selector) and tail-jumps (jmp $3E702) into the shared trace-math/define engine, which dispatches on D1 (stored to A6-0x2E and branched on). TRDEF is trace-op 0x0B (trace define).

name: TRDSP
behavior: At 0x2D448 configures the trace-display window: loads window struct from $A7D6.w, sets $AB7C/$AB80/$AB84.w=1, $AB82.w=0x15, $A9B2.b=1, clears $AB77.w bit4, sets $AB76.w bits 13/14, then calls display subroutines ($2BB16,$2BA64,$2D37E,$2BD80) and a final DLP call with source ptr 0x2F23C. Sets up/redraws the trace display.

name: TRGRPH
dlp_source: DISPOSE ONEOS;ONCMD GD;{GD=__GTSWDE;};ONCMD GD __GTPRGT;ONCMD GATE;GATE OFF;ONCM
behavior: Trampoline (0x6DAB4) running DLP source at ROM 0x6DA54: 'DISPOSE ONEOS;ONCMD GD {GD=__GTSWDE};ONCMD GD __GTPRGT;ONCMD GATE;GATE OFF;ONCMD GATE __GTPRGT;' — sets up the gated-sweep time-domain graph by redefining the GD (gate-delay→sweep-delay) and GATE command hooks and disposing the ONEOS handler.

name: TRMATH
behavior: Trampoline (0x64BE4) running DLP source at ROM 0x64B06: if FFT is active (__FFTSTF) it sets FFTSTOP=400/(ST*2) and runs the FFT step, otherwise it displays 'You must activate SINGLE FFT or CONTINUS FFT before this function is available.' Trace math/FFT control.

name: TRPRST
behavior: At 0x00ABDE writes 0x0002 to the HD63484 ACRTC command register $F5FC.w and 0x0180 to data register $F5FE.w (write-parameter-register 2 = display control word CCR 0x0180, the 2bpp control), then rts. Reprograms the ACRTC display control.

name: TRSTAT
behavior: Trace-status query; returns the current trace state as RE-SENDABLE parser commands. BENCH-VERIFIED: `TRSTAT?` -> `CLRW A;BLANK B;BLANK C;`. DLP-source trampoline. Capture-and-replay backs up/restores trace display state.

name: TTPXL
behavior: Handler at 0x24B6A is 'clr.w $9FD0.w; rts', clearing a trace-plot state variable; the adjacent routine at 0x24B76 converts an amplitude value in D0 to a display pixel row (clamps 0xFC18→0, 0xE9BC→0x38, else /0x64 with 8-pixel quantization). Trace-to-pixel plotting init/conversion.

name: TVLINE6
behavior: Unresolved (handler_pc=0, tag 0x30, category tv/catv); did not resolve through the dispatch tables and the name suffix is a name-table over-read. Best-effort: the TV-trigger 'TV LINE' command (selects the TV line number for the video-trigger/CATV option).

name: TVSFRMQj
behavior: Unresolved (handler_pc=0, tag 0x30, category tv/catv); name is a garbled name-table read. Best-effort: a TV-trigger frame/field command ('TV FRAME'-class) of the video/CATV option; exact behavior not derivable without the handler.

name: TVSTNDdk
behavior: Unresolved (handler_pc=0, tag 0x30, category tv/catv); garbled name suffix. Best-effort: the 'TV STANDARD' command that selects the TV broadcast standard for the video-trigger/CATV option.

name: TVSYNC7l
behavior: Unresolved (handler_pc=0, tag 0x30, category tv/catv); garbled name suffix. Best-effort: the 'TV SYNC' command selecting TV sync polarity/type for the video-trigger/CATV option.

name: TVTSTAT
behavior: At 0x27442 takes value D0; special-cases D0==0xFC19 (query sentinel) and computes a result from trace/TV-buffer longword pointers $BB4A.w and $BB4E.w via low-mem math vectors ($6118/$6106/$982), otherwise clamps and computes a buffer offset. TV/trace status read; exact semantic unclear.

name: TVTUNSET
behavior: Query handler for the TV-tune value: checks whether the command token's next char is '?' (cmpi.b #$3f,(1,A4)); if so it reads the word at RAM $b24c and formats/outputs it via $73fe/$70d2 (passing buffer $b24e), reporting the stored TV-tuning setting.

name: TVTUNSTD
behavior: Takes a longword+word numeric argument (movem.l (8,A6),D0-D1 / (16,A6)) and runs it through conversion routines $397b6 and $5dc2 before dispatching into $369f6 to set a TV-tuning-standard parameter; the $369f6 target is table-dispatched and not resolved in-window.

name: TWNDOW
behavior: Trampoline running a DLP macro that, on the ANNOT annotation flag, either clears the FFT window vars (__N,0/__A,0/EM) or initializes the FFT window (__FFTAI, conditionally __FFTCD) — the time/FFT-window setup command.

name: UDEFPV
behavior: Trampoline DLP macro gated on the __PKIF peak flag that clamps the marker-delta-line mode MKDLMODE between 0 and 1 (MXM then MIN) and toggles __PKIF0/__PKIF1 — manages user-defined peak/marker-delta state.

name: UNTIL
behavior: DLP control-flow loop terminator (pairs with REPEAT); resolves only to the shared control-flow fallback at 0x406ec (also used by IF/ELSE/ENDIF/REPEAT/RETURN), whose code merely tests $b1e0 bit12 and $b1fe==0x12 then conditionally jsr $4d8 — the real UNTIL semantics live inside the DLP interpreter, not this stub.

name: USEROFST
behavior: Stores the 32-bit command argument straight into RAM longword $bffa (move.l D0,$bffa.w) — sets the user amplitude/reference offset value.

name: USERRANGE
behavior: Tests bit 11 of the mode flag $b07a.w and branches out of the handler window to $17fb0 or $17dfc; the code that actually applies the user range lies outside the disassembled range and is not resolved here.

name: USTATE
behavior: USER-MEMORY DUMP. USTATE is a DLP array variable (special-token class type=0xc0, array ID 12 -- immediately after the trace arrays TRA=7,TRB=8,TRC=9,TRD=10). `USTATE?` outputs the ENTIRE user-memory region (downloaded DLPs, user variables, saved traces) as an HP `#A` binary block. BENCH-VERIFIED: `#A` header + ~5244 bytes on a real 8593E. Because it is a read/WRITE array like the trace registers, re-sending the captured block (bare `USTATE <#A block>` or via MOV) should RESTORE user memory -- the GPIB user-memory backup/restore path the 8563's ZRDWR was wrongly sought for. Generic array-access handler at slot 0x3F. Does NOT touch calibration NVRAM (use CAL DUMP for that).

name: UWAIT
behavior: Trampoline DLP macro that snapshots the current instrument settings into __CZ* scratch variables — LEDs via MSFIELD(8,15,16), detector DET, span SP, sweep SS, log-scale LG, atten AT, etc. — a state-save preamble for a timed wait/measurement sequence.

name: VARDEF
behavior: Defines/selects a DLP user variable: normalizes the variable index (subtracting the 0x218e/0x5a bands), bounds-checks it to 0..6, indexes the ROM table at 0x1a242 to store a value into $9fb4, and writes the variable token (+0x218e) into the current-variable pointer $bfee.

name: VARIANCE
behavior: Trampoline running the short DLP sequence __PKAM;M2;NV (peak-amplitude / marker-2 / NV) — a marker-math routine producing a trace variance/statistics readout.

name: VAVG
behavior: Did not resolve through the dispatch tables (pc=0); by name and arg_type 0x07 this is most likely the video/trace-averaging control command (VAVG = Video AVeraGe).

name: VBO
behavior: Trampoline running the DLP fragment 'KH /GATE|' — a key/menu macro that invokes the GATE softkey path.

name: VGDAC
behavior: Despite the 'DAC' name, this trampoline's DLP macro drives graticule/channel-power annotation: __CHPANLBL, toggles GRAT (GRAT0/GRAT1), clears the channel-power marker (ACPMK=-1) and BLANKs — a display/annotation macro, not a DAC write.

name: VIEW
behavior: Puts a trace into VIEW mode — tests the trace-active flag $b0e6.w, then calls $3efde with mode value 2 (trace-view) to freeze/display the trace without further writes (or jsr $2bc when already active).

name: VKBDCONFIG
behavior: Reads the keyboard-config longword at RAM $bf12, masks the sign bit when negative, and formats/outputs it via $64fa/$62f0/$6016 (or $5dc4) — a query returning the keyboard-configuration value.

name: VRD
behavior: Resolves only to the generic 3-instruction routine at 0xabde (a fallback shared by 13 commands incl. WINON/WINOFF/WARN/WAIT) that writes ACRTC command 0x0002 and param 0x0180 to display regs 0xFFF5FC/0xFFF5FE; this is not VRD's real handler. Best-effort by name: a video/VRAM read.

name: WAIT
behavior: GPIB WAIT (hold command execution until pending operations complete); resolves only to the shared 0xabde fallback (the ACRTC 0x0002/0x0180 write shared by 13 commands), so the true WAIT handler is not captured here.

name: WARN
behavior: Handler at 0x00abde is a 3-instruction ACRTC helper: writes 0x0002 to the HD63484 command port 0xFFF5FC and 0x0180 to its data port 0xFFF5FE, then rts. The same PC is shared by WARN/WARNC/WARNE/WARNPRO/WINOFF (five semantically-unrelated names), so this is a dispatch-table default, not a resolved per-command handler.

name: WARNC
behavior: Points at the same shared PC 0x00abde: writes ACRTC command port 0xFFF5FC=0x0002 and data port 0xFFF5FE=0x0180 then returns. Shared across five unrelated command names, so the mapping is an unresolved dispatch default.

name: WARNE
behavior: Same shared handler 0x00abde (ACRTC write of cmd 0x0002 / data 0x0180 to 0xFFF5FC/0xFFF5FE). Shared by five unrelated names, indicating a defaulted/unresolved dispatch rather than a WARNE-specific routine.

name: WARNF
behavior: Handler at 0x05ecb6 is a getter: move.w $94de.w,D0; rts — reads the 16-bit ADC-calibration status word at RAM 0xFFFF94DE (part of the ADC-cal block that also touches $94e0/$94d6/$948a/$94da/$94da) and returns it. The PC is shared by WARNF/WARNH/WARNP/WARNPRN, so the name-to-handler mapping is a dispatch default, not verified.

name: WARNH
behavior: Same shared handler 0x05ecb6 reading ADC-cal status word RAM $94de into D0 and returning. Four unrelated WARN* names collapse onto this one PC, so treat the mapping as an unresolved default.

name: WARNP
behavior: Same shared handler 0x05ecb6 (returns ADC-cal status word $94de). Shared across WARNF/WARNH/WARNP/WARNPRN — the disasm is a simple getter but its assignment to WARNP is a dispatch default, not confirmed.

name: WARNPRN
behavior: Same shared handler 0x05ecb6 returning RAM word $94de (ADC-cal status). Shared PC across four names, so the WARNPRN mapping is unresolved/defaulted.

name: WARNPRO
behavior: Shares the 0x00abde ACRTC helper (writes 0x0002 to 0xFFF5FC and 0x0180 to 0xFFF5FE, then rts). One of five unrelated names on this PC, so it is a dispatch default rather than a WARNPRO-specific handler.

name: WINACTIVE
behavior: DLP-source trampoline: sets display attribute DA=__V and, when __S==0, pen-ups and draws TEXT strings at pen positions loaded from the __J/__N and __I/__M coordinate variables — paints the active-window annotation/label text.

name: WINANNOT
behavior: Native handler at 0x05b1a4 bounds-checks the argument D0 to 0..3 (out-of-range returns 0) then returns a 16-bit word from a 4-entry, stride-6 table at RAM ~0xFFFF99FC indexed by D0 — a window-annotation code lookup.

name: WINCLOSE
behavior: DLP trampoline running the source `__GTWINSWAP;NV` — swaps/closes the active graphics window via the __GTWINSWAP sub, then NV.

name: WINCOUNT
behavior: DLP trampoline `IF(GSTAT(1));KB;ELSE;KH /GATE|LENGTH/,ACTVF __GTLMKR,0;ENDIF` — if gate status GSTAT(1) is set it does KB, otherwise it installs a GATE/LENGTH softkey that activates __GTLMKR (gated-sweep length/marker setup).

name: WINFMT
behavior: DLP trampoline `__ACPES;__ACPEM;NV` — runs the two window-format setup subs __ACPES and __ACPEM (adjacent-channel-power measurement window formatting) followed by NV.

name: WININIT
behavior: DLP trampoline computing window/zone init values from sweep parameters: __CZBS = SP*(__K-__J+1)/401 (channel-zone bin size from span) and __CZBN = 1.128*RB (noise bandwidth from RBW), with a detector-dependent adjustment (IF DET==1 then __CZBN += SP/400...).

name: WINITM
behavior: DLP trampoline `KH 'FFT STOP|FREQ',ACTVF FFTSTOP` — defines a softkey labeled 'FFT STOP FREQ' that, when pressed, activates the FFTSTOP command.

name: WINLABEL
behavior: Native handler at 0x05b6e2 copies a 4-byte label descriptor from the pointer arg at (0xc,A6), maps its orientation char 'H'(0x48)->1 / 'V'(0x56)->2 / else 0, then indexes the per-window label table at RAM ~0xFFFF9A14 using the current window index $956c — sets a window's horizontal/vertical label.

name: WINNEXT
behavior: Native handler at 0x040002 dispatches on the current command/state word $bb8a: for 0x3b it bset bit7 of $b0e5 (then jsr $418), for 0x3e bit8 and 0x3f bit12 of $b0e4 (jsr $418), for 0x6c it jsr $51a with D0=3 — a menu/flag state setter keyed on $bb8a.

name: WINOFF
behavior: Shares the 0x00abde ACRTC helper (writes 0x0002 to command port 0xFFF5FC and 0x0180 to data port 0xFFF5FE, then rts). One of five unrelated names on this PC, so the WINOFF mapping is a dispatch default, not a confirmed window-off handler.

name: WINON
behavior: Writes ACRTC command 0x0002 to $FFF5FC then data 0x0180 to $FFF5FE (the HD63484 register-select + data ports), i.e. programs a display-controller register to turn the window/display on.

name: WINOPEN
behavior: Parses its argument for a '#A'-style length-4 binary block header (arg byte0=0x04, byte1=0x23 '#', byte2=0x41 'A'), extracts two window params (bytes 3,4), then copies the window template from RAM $b24c into the destination buffer (or copies the raw arg bytes otherwise) to initialize a window definition.

name: WINSETFMT
behavior: Trampoline running DLP source `TEXT~ ~;NV` — emits a blank fixed-width TEXT field template followed by NV, setting the window's display text format.

name: WINSTAT
behavior: Window-status query. BENCH-VERIFIED: `WINSTAT?` -> `-9999` (sentinel = no active window). DLP-source trampoline.

name: WINSTATE
behavior: Trampoline running DLP `IF(HAVE(GATE));VRD __GGTENTR,0;VRD __GGTIN,0;VRD __GGTVB,0;VRD __GGTRB,0;...` — when the GATE option is present, resets the batch of gate DLP state variables to 0 to initialize the gate window state.

name: WINZOOM
behavior: Trampoline running DLP `{DA=__V;};IF(__S==1);{PA=60;PA=180;};TEXT% %;...` — assigns display var DA=__V and, when __S==1, sets pen-address PA=60/180 and writes a blank TEXT field to position/draw the zoomed window region.

name: WKP
behavior: Native: indexes a per-window table via $956c.w (window/menu id x10) at base -$65ec, checks the entry's validity word, and if valid with D0<=0x37 pushes the arg and calls the window field-setters $5a62a/$5a6ca to store the keypress/parameter into the window structure; returns -1 (0xFFFF) on failure.

name: WRNM
behavior: Native getter: `move.w $94de.w, D0; rts` — reads the warning register/number word from RAM $94de into D0 and returns it.

name: WRNO
behavior: Native getter sharing the exact same handler as WRNM (pc 0x5ecb6): reads the warning word from RAM $94de into D0 and returns it.

name: XCH
behavior: Native: when arg==0 it tests via low-mem $18a and, if a status bit is set, performs a swap through helpers $6ef8/$32c22/$71e4/$70d2; otherwise it clamps the numeric arg to >=2 (default 0x191=401, the trace length), scales it via $7978, and copies a 3-byte record template from ROM $3a134 into a stack buffer. Exact exchanged buffers are table/helper-dispatched and not concretely resolved.

name: XLAT
behavior: Native thin wrapper: `link; move.l D0,(A7); jsr $a2a.w; unlk; rts` — passes its argument in D0 and dispatches to the low-memory API/jump-table routine at $a2a (a translate/lookup call whose target is not resolvable from this stub).

name: YTFDAC
behavior: Trampoline running DLP `__ACPSUD;TRC-8000;VIEW TRC;M1;__CHPCG;NV` — runs an analog/power-supply update, drives the trace to -8000, VIEWs it, sets marker M1 and calls __CHPCG; a YTF (YIG-tuned-filter) DAC alignment sequence acting on the trace and markers.

name: YTFDATAR
behavior: Trampoline running DLP `ANNOT0;EM;__PKNSP;__PKNAU;KEYDEF8049,/HD;/;WININIT;WINOPEN __W,0,60,400,140;...` — disables annotation, erases, runs peak routines, defines softkey 8049 and opens/inits a window; sets up the YTF-data read user-interface/menu window.

name: YTFDATAW
behavior: Trampoline running DLP `{FOR(__MN[19]=37;__MN[19]<49&&(!(__MN[20]=MSFIELD(__MN[19],4,5))||MSFIELD(...` — loops over menu/measurement field indices 37..48 reading MSFIELD values into the __MN[] array to write out the YTF calibration data.

name: ZMK
behavior: Native trampoline: pushes its arg block and calls $3d32c, which in turn writes two 16-bit fields (at offsets arg and arg+2) via $3d2de into a marker/zone data structure. Builds a 4-byte zone-marker record; the exact target buffer is not fully resolved.

name: ZMKACT
behavior: Native: reads display/zone control word $bc64.w, clears its top two bits (AND 0x3fff) and sets bit15 (OR 0x8000) writing it back, sets the zone-marker-active flag $9b26.w=1, then calls the redraw routine $561e8 — activates the zone marker.

name: ZMKCP
behavior: Native: when arg==0 and the length count $b12a.w >= 8, copies $b12a bytes from source table at (-$4ed6,A4) into a local stack buffer, then scans from index 3 for a ':' (0x3a) delimiter — parses/copies a colon-delimited zone-marker string of length $b12a.

name: ZMKLEFT
behavior: Native clamp helper: returns 0 if D0<0, returns the arg upper bound ($8,A6) if D0 exceeds it, else returns D0 — clamps a value to the range [0, arg] to compute the zone-marker left/lower boundary.

name: ZMKLPOS
behavior: Native marker-left-position calculator: reads marker index $a9a0.w, calls trap $15a and helper fcn.7978, and maps the position into a 2000-point (0x7d0) sweep-coordinate range via a divs, indexing the $b0c8.w/$b0e6.w marker tables and setting $bb06.w=1.

name: ZMKPK
behavior: Native arithmetic wrapper: calls helper fcn.88de and returns (result+1)>>1 (a rounded/averaged marker-peak value); no hardware or MMIO access.

name: ZMKPKNL
behavior: Resolves to a 3-instruction stub at 0xABDE that writes ACRTC command 0x0002 / data 0x0180 to HD63484 ports 0xFFF5FC/0xFFF5FE (a display control-word write); this shared address does not match a 'peak-next-left' marker op and is almost certainly a dispatch-table mis-resolution.

name: ZMKPKNR
behavior: Resolves to the SAME 0xABDE stub as ZMKPKNL, writing ACRTC command 0x0002 / data 0x0180 to 0xFFF5FC/0xFFF5FE; the identical shared address for two distinct marker commands indicates a dispatch mis-resolution rather than the real 'peak-next-right' handler.

name: ZMKRIGHT
behavior: Native: indexes a marker table at (A4-0x6108) by arg*2 into $b206.w, sets/clears bit14 of $b204.w depending on whether the arg is <10, then drives MMIO 0xFFF710<-$b206 and 0xFFF712<-$b204 (marker/sweep hardware registers) and invokes traps $232/$238.

name: ZMKRPOS
behavior: Unresolved (pc=0); handler not recovered via the dispatch tables. By name, the marker right-edge position counterpart to ZMKLPOS (reports/sets the right marker limit); not confirmed by disassembly.

name: ZMKTYPE
behavior: Unresolved (pc=0); handler not recovered. By name, sets or reports the marker type (e.g. normal/delta/span-pair); not confirmed by disassembly.

name: ZTGAOFST
behavior: Unresolved (pc=0); handler not recovered. By name, the tracking-generator amplitude/level offset (TG output-power offset); not confirmed by disassembly.

name: __ACPAC
behavior: Native ACP handler: fetches a numeric argument list via trap $2f2 (count into -6(A6), pointer into D0), and when count>1 iterates the list adding offset $a(A6) and passing each element through helpers fcn.e30a and fcn.b3f4.

name: __ACPANF
behavior: Native: guards on fcn.36166 (ready/valid, bit0) and fcn.3a05a, then reads a byte length from the argument pointer (A4), computes (count+1)>>1, and copies/processes the length-prefixed block into a local -0x2a(A6) buffer; exact ACP field meaning not pinned down.

name: __ACPANLBL
behavior: Native: fetches an arg via fcn.3070c, validates range 0..15, then writes a 4-bit field (bits 1-4) of RAM control word $b19e.w = (arg<<1)&0x1e with the surrounding bits preserved, and refreshes via fcn.30b3a.

name: __ACPANNOT
behavior: Native: fetches an arg list via trap $2f2; if count>1 it passes the list pointer to fcn.6c02 and returns result+1, otherwise returns 0 — a thin arg-list dispatcher for the ACP annotation path.

name: __ACPANRES
behavior: Native: stores the argument word into RAM $ba58.w, loads $b076.w into D0, and calls fcn.80a0 (the amplitude/measurement recompute), i.e. sets an ACP resolution parameter and triggers a measurement refresh.

name: __ACPANTIC
behavior: Native query: a 2-instruction getter `move.w $b19e.w,D0; rts` that returns the ACP annotation control word $b19e.w (the same field __ACPANLBL writes).

name: __ACPAUTO
behavior: Native: fetches an arg list via trap $2f2 and, when non-empty, drives helpers fcn.6314/fcn.6280/fcn.643e with immediate 0x64000007 and populates the $b24c.w parameter table — an ACP auto-setup that programs a parameter block.

name: __ACPAUTOB
behavior: Native: fetches a boolean arg via fcn.306da and sets (bit0=1) or clears (bit0=0) bit 11 of RAM control word $b0d6.w, then refreshes via fcn.30e00 — an ON/OFF toggle.

name: __ACPBW
behavior: Native: gated on flags bit3/bit2 of $ab77.w, compares the argument to segment/channel count $a9ae.w and conditionally calls fcn.2d8fe/fcn.2bab8, decrementing $a9ae.w — manipulates the ACP band/segment list.

name: __ACPBWC
behavior: Native: clears $acca.w, then per an internal branch either zeroes $ad0c.w and copies parameter block $b12a into $acca via fcn.6a2e, or sets $ad0c.w=0xFFFF and copies block $b164 — selecting one of two ACP bandwidth-coupling configurations.

name: __ACPC
behavior: Fetches a word-array descriptor via the DLP array helper jsr $2f2.w (pointer into (-$8,A6), element count into (-$a,A6)), then loops sign-extending each word and accumulating them into D6; returns the running sum in D0.

name: __ACPCC
behavior: On arg==0 it reads a flag via jsr $18a.w (btst #0) and runs a copy/emit path ($6ef8, $32c22, $71e4, $70d2); otherwise it clamps the arg to >=0x191, transforms it via $7978, then builds a 3-byte code from ROM table $3a134 and appends the arg byte — constructing/dispatching an ACP command code.

name: __ACPCG
behavior: Entry immediately bra's to $af28 (body outside the disassembled window); the reachable code reads status byte $ba87.w (valid range 0..9) and maps it through a jump table into result cell (-$a,A6), returning a small mapped code.

name: __ACPDONE
behavior: Calls $5687c, then if RAM count $b12a.w > 0 iterates that many entries, reading a byte table at (A4-$4ed6) and calling $56414 per entry, then finalizes via $56c62 and $56096 (adjacent code sets $9afb bit2) — flushing/completing the ACP entry list.

name: __ACPDV
behavior: Loads the DLP menu/struct pointer at $9562.w and reads offset $50, calls $154.w, then (gated on $afcf.w bit0) walks a descriptor block via PC-relative tables $27a86/$27b32, calling $27b88 and $27f62 on non-null longword fields — manipulating a DLP menu/struct.

name: __ACPEC
behavior: The dispatch PC lands in a moveq jump-table slot (moveq #2,D1) that tail-jumps to the common routine at $3e702; it selects enum/error code 2 in D1 and hands off to that shared ACP dispatcher.

name: __ACPEM
behavior: Operates on the ACP entry array (pointer $bb54.w, count $bb52.w, length $bfe6.w): clamps the arg to [1,0x64], reads/writes the index byte $bff1.w, and shifts entries (A2)->(A3) to insert/edit within the buffer.

name: __ACPERR
behavior: Calls $6ef8 then for bit index 7..0 reads a bit-mask table at $3f2cc and tests the status word $b072.w; for each set bit it indexes a longword table at $3f29c and calls $7154.w to emit — reporting ACP error/status flags held in $b072.

name: __ACPES
behavior: Thin wrapper that links, saves D0, calls system routine jsr $4cfe.w and returns; the actual effect lives in $4cfe and is not visible within the handler window.

name: __ACPGR
behavior: Seeds D0=0 and calls setup routine $2dc60, then forwards three word arguments ((-$8/-$a/-$c relative to A6 / stack $8/$a/$c) to the common routine $2e816 (the sibling variant at $2e926 uses D0=1) — invoking ACP group/graph operation index 0.

name: __ACPICALC
behavior: Fetches an array via $2f2; if non-empty it computes the sum-of-squares via $3e160 then runs a chain of FP-math library calls ($5df0,$64f0,$6016,$5e36,$6060,$6802) — a statistical calculation (mean/variance/RMS) over the array.

name: __ACPM
behavior: Thin wrapper: pushes the longword arg at stack ($8,A6) and calls $3d32c (a single store/access primitive), then tail-returns — a single-element ACP store/move (companion of the two-element __ACPS).

name: __ACPMK
behavior: Pushes constant selector 4 (move.w #$4,-(A7)) and calls $3efde; sibling entries push 3 and 5 into the same routine — invoking the ACP marker/mask handler $3efde with code 4.

name: __ACPPI
behavior: Entry bra's to $3a822 (body outside window); the reachable subroutine indexes the ACP entry array at pointer $bb54.w (mask 0xfff), copies the selected entry into buffer $b24c.w and calls $35e — reading/writing the [$bb54] entry array and $b24c working buffer.

name: __ACPPWRUP
behavior: Fetches two array descriptors via $2f2, processes them through $6bb8.w, then reads a flag via $aea.w and (bit0 set) writes sentinel 0xffff into the first array, finalizing via $9ee.w — power-up initialization of the ACP arrays.

name: __ACPRCLP
behavior: Recall-panel routine: on arg==0xfc19 it takes a special path (math $6118, base pointers $bb4e.w and $bb4a.w), otherwise it validates the arg against a limit ($322), computes a table offset (+0x191, scaled via $6106/$6118) added to base $bb4e.w — recalling a saved ACP parameter/panel from the [$bb4a/$bb4e] table.

name: __ACPS
behavior: Calls $3d32c twice — first with stack arg ($8,A6) at base address D0, then with ($c,A6) at D0+4 — storing two consecutive longwords; a two-element ACP store (companion of single-element __ACPM).

name: __ACPSAVP
behavior: Save-panel routine: computes the target via $274d4 then uses a computed branch to dispatch to one of several store/emit paths referencing ROM constants $2b4ba/$2b482/$2b4ca/$2b4d0 through $22c/$2da — saving an ACP panel/parameter (complement of __ACPRCLP).

name: __ACPSKA
behavior: Small accessor (link/deref/rts): takes a pointer argument, loads it into A4 and returns the 32-bit longword at *arg (move.l (A4),D0). A generic get-element accessor used by the ACP DLP; no MMIO/cal touch.

name: __ACPSKB
behavior: Guard routine: reads config/state byte $bf02.w and compares to 0x5f; unless equal it calls subroutine $2c22 before rts. Conditional invocation gated on the $bf02 state byte.

name: __ACPSP
behavior: Copies a length-prefixed (Pascal) string of up to 12 bytes from its pointer argument into the RAM buffer at $ac47.w (byte-by-byte via dbra); if the length byte is <=0 or >=13 it just clears the length byte at $ac47. Stores an ACP label/title string.

name: __ACPSUA
behavior: Dispatches on $b07a.w bit 11 and $adc4.w bit 15, then reads the trace amplitude array via the display-array pointer $9552.w (indexed word reads) and converts values through helper $1cec2, using $b0c8 as an index. An ACP-value computation over the trace buffer.

name: __ACPSUD
behavior: Parses two arguments via $2f2, reads sweep/frequency state $b0c6.w (span) and $b080.w (center), pushes them with a mode flag and calls compute routine $411a4, and checks arg[1]=='A' (0x41). An ACP band/delta computation.

name: __ACPSUK
behavior: Loads ROM template pointer 0x17806 into D0 and calls output helper $7154 (which formats it into the response buffer $bbca via $4326) then terminator $70d2. Emits a fixed query-response string built from ROM template 0x17806.

name: __ACPSUM
behavior: Seeds config byte $b05c.w from $9b20.w, then falls to $546f4 which calls helper $6862 before returning. Copies an HP-IB/keyboard address-style config byte and runs a measurement-setup helper.

name: __ACPSUPV
behavior: Parses an argument via $6ef8, range-checks it against 0x62/0x63, and validates/indexes the RAM table spanning $a7da.w..$a896.w (using char-compare and helper $439a). An ACP setup-value validation against a table.

name: __ACPSUTV
behavior: Parses two arguments via $2f2, compares them, points A4 at RAM buffer $b24c.w when equal, then loops over a count argument iterating a table structure. An ACP table-value fill/read over $b24c.

name: __AMACT
behavior: Entry dispatches via $598b6; one branch sets display-mode flag $bc64.w bit 13 and scans/copies the entered string in buffer $9AD6 (length at $9ad6, chars scanned for space 0x20) into a local. An AM 'active' measurement setup that consumes the $9AD6 entry buffer.

name: __AMANOT
behavior: Guard/dispatch: range-checks RAM token word $bfee.w against [0x218d,0x2195]; in-range branches to body $4b532, otherwise to $4b71e. The body/data past 0x4b486 is a table (disassembles as zero-fill), so only the gate is confirmed.

name: __AMDISP
behavior: Calls $5862a, masks display-mode flags $bc64.w &= 0xf007 (clears bits 3-11), copies $bc28.w -> $bc26.w, and calls display setup $561e8. Configures the AM measurement display mode.

name: __AMLGSCL
behavior: AM log-scale set: gets arg via $5de94, sets $bffe.w=0x204, converts the value through $643e and stores it to $94ee.w clamped to [0,0xFFFF], sets valid-flag $94ec.w, then calls $ff74. Writes the log-scale value/flag.

name: __AMLNSCL
behavior: Despite the 'linear scale' name, the handler reads MMIO POST/status latches 0xFFF612 and 0xFFF610, NOTs the word, and outputs it plus RAM words $bb2e/$bb30/$bb32 as a comma-separated, terminated response (via $71e4/$70ca/$70d2). It is a diagnostic status query, not a scale setter — name/behavior mismatch (possible dispatch mis-resolution).

name: __AMMEAS
behavior: Arms an AM measurement: writes measurement control block $ab7c/$ab80/$ab84=1, $ab82=0x15, $a9b2=1, clears $ab77.w bit4, sets $ab76.w bits 13/14, sets $ab7e=1, and calls measurement subs ($2bb16/$2ba64/$2bd80/$2c5b2) plus loads DLP source 0x2f23c via $730.

name: __AMNOSIG
behavior: If $b0e6.w > 0 it aborts via $2bc (D0=1) and exits; otherwise it parses arguments via $32c22 (x2) and $3e318 and bounds-checks them to [1,0x400]. Validates AM 'no-signal'/measurement parameters.

name: __AMRUN
behavior: Thin wrapper: bsr $2d2c2, which draws a rect via $39a (params 0xaaaa,0xaf,0x18f,1), calls $2d21c(D0=4), clears measurement-active flag $ab7e.w, and calls $76c/$62e. Restarts/redraws the AM measurement.

name: __AMSIG
behavior: Dispatches on the command token in D0 (0x3421,0x2b0f,0x2b44,0x30e,0x30f,...) and, via helper $19754, sets or clears the corresponding bit in annunciator/flag word $bff6.w (bits 0xa/0x9/0xe etc.), or stores an arg to $9fbc.w. An AM signal/annunciator flag setter.

name: __AMTERM
behavior: Native handler at 0x22c9a: calls $223a2, then on $bfee (mode word, compared to 0x2190) and flag $b0c8 selects among ROM string/descriptor constants (0x4786A, 0x7271) and copies 8-byte descriptor pairs into locals to format an amplitude/units terminator label. Exact semantic (which string) not pinned down.

name: __CHPANLBL
behavior: Native at 0x5b1d2: takes an argument string pointer; if the first byte is 0 it defaults to the menu register $956a, otherwise string-matches the arg against ROM constants (0x5be84/0x5be8e) via the compare routine jsr $6a52 to select a channel-annotation label id.

name: __CHPANRES
behavior: Native at 0x5ba7e: after a guard jsr $18a and a count from __CHPM (bsr $5b16a), tests/sets flag $956e.w and restores the 4-entry, 6-byte-record annotation table at $-6604(A4) by copying saved words from the table at $-6a90(A0) (a 'restore' of the CHP annotation state).

name: __CHPANTIC
behavior: Native at 0x5b410: copies a 26-byte (0x1A) record from the arg pointer into a local buffer, then scans the 4-entry annotation table at $-6604(A4) (limit index 3) for a free/next slot — adds/positions an annotation ('tic') entry.

name: __CHPC
behavior: Native at 0x5b380: if menu register $956a is set it deletes that menu (bsr $5b236) and rebuilds the menu via the menu-loader bsr $5acb2, then clears the annotation-table records (clr.w $-6604(A4) and $-65ec(A4)) for indices 1..2 — a clear/reset of the channel-annotation display.

name: __CHPCG
behavior: Native at 0x4d992: if count $9fb4 > 1, opens a string builder (jsr $6ef8) and loops $9fb4-1 times reading longword entries from the table at $-5fba(A4), converting each (jsr $5140) and appending (jsr $7154/$70ca) to build a formatted list/graph string.

name: __CHPERR
behavior: Native at 0x5b7c2: if the channel menu $956c has a valid record ($-65ec(A4)!=0) and the arg code D0<=0x37, writes softkey/message text into that menu slot via bsr $5a62a and bsr $5a6ca — posts an error/message string on the CHP menu.

name: __CHPGR
behavior: Native getter at 0x3d44e: returns the 32-bit value stored in RAM $bffa.w (move.l $bffa.w,D0; rts) — reads a global CHP register/pointer.

name: __CHPM
behavior: Native at 0x5b16a: iterates indices 0..3 over the 6-byte-record table at $-6604(A4) and returns in D0 the count of records whose first word is non-zero — counts active channel-annotation/marker entries.

name: __CHPS
behavior: Native at 0x5b6e2: copies a 4-byte record from the arg pointer at $c(A6) into a local buffer, extracts the first-byte code (ext.w) and branches on it (compares against 0x48 'H' etc.) to select a channel-annotation display state/units.

name: __FFAFFTM
behavior: Native at 0x3c18c: reads setting $a35a (negated as a default), bounds-checks the arg record's first byte against 0x1e (30 entries) and on overflow reports an error with ROM string 0x3d0fe (jsr $2da); processes an FFT/trace marker entry within a 30-slot table.

name: __FFAPC
behavior: Native at 0x3b3cc: invokes the shared FF dispatcher bsr $3b27e with selector 5 (which registers bit 5 in flag word $bef8 and handles the '?' query); on success computes a value (jsr $62a6/$64ba) and stores the 32-bit result to $bf1a.w.

name: __FFATOC
behavior: Native thin wrapper at 0x3b330: pushes the arg and calls the shared FF dispatcher bsr $3b27e with selector 0x0d, which sets bit 0x0d in the FF flag word $bef8 (and answers a trailing '?' as a query) then returns.

name: __FFCALC
behavior: Native getter at 0x3d2c8: even-aligns the arg pointer (bclr #0 of its low byte) and returns the 16-bit word read from that address (move.w (A4),D0; rts) — a fetch of a word at the given RAM address.

name: __FFCFFTM
behavior: Native at 0x2d5c4: iterates an FFT-marker index table at $-5652(A4) (word-indexed), and for each non-empty slot loads the 8-byte record from $-5624(A0) (index*8) and processes rows with a 0x28 (40) stride — walks/computes the FFT marker records.

name: __FFCLIP
behavior: Native at 0xcf8c: sets clipping-enable flags in RAM $b213 — arg==1 sets bit 3 (else clears it), arg==2 sets bit 5 (else clears it); toggles two clip-mode bits.

name: __FFFSM
behavior: Native at 0x3f63e: builds a formatted status string (jsr $6ef8 open, template ptr 0x40604 via jsr $7154, close via jsr $70ca) using index $b234 to look up a byte in the table pointed to by $a80 — formats an FF state/mode message.

name: __FFLCLPK
behavior: Native at 0x271c0: runs a local-peak search loop (bsr $26ef4/$26a2a/$26b5a) that, gated on flag $ac76 and $acc9 bit 4, captures the peak position from $ac78 and accumulates $ac7c into a running total while stepping a 0x20 index — a local peak-find over sweep/marker RAM.

name: __FFMUHKC
behavior: Reads state words $b0e6 and $b0ec: if $b0e6>0 dispatches D0=1 via jsr $2bc, else if $b0ec==0x31 dispatches D0=2 via $2bc; the default path calls $3b27e with D0=6, i.e. set/query bit 6 of the $bef8 flag register (with '?'-query support).

name: __FFRLA
behavior: Toggles annotation state (tests $ab7f.0, clears $ab77.4) then redraws a display element id 0x191 twice at +$a9ac and -$a9ac through the display objects at $9556/$955e (jsr $6b9e), finishing with $2bc44 and $2c5b2 — a symmetric limit/reference-line redraw driven by amplitude value $a9ac.

name: __FFSFFTM
behavior: Pure getter: if $ab77 bit4 is set it returns bits [6:5] of $ab76 (lsr #5, mask 3 → 0..3), otherwise returns 4, in D0. Queries a small mode field.

name: __FFSID
behavior: String-compares the argument against constant $41d5c ($6a52); on match, if any of $b0b0/$b0aa/$b0b6/$b0bc is nonzero and $bef8 bit10 is set it sets bit1 of $a5d5, then emits code 0x4c via jsr $184.

name: __FFSIM
behavior: Sets $b20e bit13 (busy/guard) and jsr $178, sets $b072 bit9 (a display/label-enable flag), issues command 0x74 via jsr $4c0, then clears $b20e bit13.

name: __FFSSHKC
behavior: Guarded by $a380: copies the argument string (byte count clamped to 0xc via $7978) into RAM buffer $a386, storing the length at $a382 and length+1 at $a385, and toggles the $a380 busy flag around the copy.

name: __FFSTOC
behavior: Calls $3b27e with selector 2 (query bit 2 of the $bef8 flag register); if that bit is set it sets bit15 of $befa.

name: __FFSTPA
behavior: Reads the hardkey-menu register $b1ee; when $b1ee < -1 it computes menu index (-b1ee-2)*5 and emits the 5 softkey-label strings for that menu from the longword table at $3c6ac via jsr $7154, each followed by separator 0x1c ($708a).

name: __FFTAC
behavior: Argument parser with query support: if arg byte[1]=='?' it emits the value $a35a via $3a308 (context 0x6000); otherwise it validates the leading token byte against limit 0x1e (30) before further processing. $a35a holds the queried state.

name: __FFTAI
behavior: Thin wrapper: pushes the constant token/string pointer $3d108 and calls the shared __FFTAC parser at $3a374 with D0=0.

name: __FFTAMC
behavior: Trampoline that loads selector D1=1 and jmps to the shared numeric parameter set/query routine at $3e702 (which parses the numeric arg via $2f2). Which physical parameter selector 1 controls is not resolvable from this stub.

name: __FFTAMD
behavior: Indexes a word table in high RAM (effective ~$b060 + index*2) after fetching a parameter via $7c0, tests the bit selected by arg word ($8,A6) with btst (sne), and emits the resulting 0/1 via jsr $77e.

name: __FFTCD
behavior: Emits the HP/488.2 arbitrary-block header '#A' (0x2341) via $7108, then the length word ($8,A6), then outputs that many data bytes ($73fe/$7068) — formats a binary definite-length block response.

name: __FFTCLAC
behavior: Trampoline that loads selector D1=0x0c and jmps to the shared numeric parameter set/query routine at $3e702 (same family as __FFTAMC). The specific parameter controlled by selector 12 is not resolvable from this stub.

name: __FFTCO
behavior: Keyword parser: matches the argument against several constant strings ($e520/$e526/$e52a via $6a52) and stores the supplied value into distinct config cells — $baa0 (with value transform via $b38e/$c30a +0x5000), $ba96, or $ba98 — depending on which keyword matched.

name: __FFTDEFS
behavior: Emits the literal characters 'HP' (0x4850) via $7108, then the value from $bfee.w via $71e4, then a message terminator ($708a/$70d2) — outputs an 'HP'-prefixed response string carrying $bfee.

name: __FFTEXIT
behavior: Pure getter: reads the word at $bfee.w and returns it in D0 (an exit/status/current-command code register).

name: __FFTFC
behavior: Allocates a ~0x112-byte stack buffer, clears $a990.b, and iterates 12-byte records (fetched via $6bb0, processed via $72a) comparing the words at frame offsets -0x114/-0x116 and referencing table $b24c; the exact subsystem it walks is not clear from the entry code.

name: __FFTI
behavior: Sets the 2-bit FFT-mode field in RAM state word $bc64 (masks 0x3FFF, ORs 0x4000 → field=01), clears state word $9b26, then calls the FFT redraw/setup routine $561e8.

name: __FFTKEYS
behavior: FFT softkey-menu handler: errors out (jsr $2bc) when the front-panel-busy flag $b0e6>0, otherwise clears long $bf0a, reads keyboard/state byte $bf02 and cal-scratch RAM $2fc003, and dispatches the FFT menu/softkey ('_'=0x5f) via $54d78/$7128/$754c.

name: __FFTMI
behavior: Stores the command argument word into RAM word $9e50; if the parsed numeric arg is zero it issues internal command/menu index 0x37 via jsr $42a.

name: __FFTONIP
behavior: Gated by helper $5de94; when enabled it calls low-mem API routine $ff74 and toggles FFT sub-mode processing via $5df8c/$5dfd2 (selector args 0/1, checking $94ec), otherwise disables them (selector 4).

name: __FFTPAAC
behavior: Stores the argument word into RAM state word $ba54, then loads $b076 and dispatches an internal command via jsr $1af8.

name: __FFTPAMC
behavior: Enumerated 5-choice parameter using the keyword table at ROM $40694: on '?' query it reads the packed setting $b0aa and outputs the current choice ($7154/$70d2); on set it parses the keyword (jsr $39762) and updates $b0aa via $40dc2.

name: __FFTPAMK
behavior: Trivial setter — stores the command argument word into RAM state word $9b24.

name: __FFTPAMM
behavior: Enumerated 4-choice parameter analogous to FFTPAMC using the keyword table at ROM $406a8: '?' query outputs the current choice from $b0aa; set parses the keyword (jsr $39762), errors ('O' via jsr $184) on choice 3, else updates $b0aa via $40dc2.

name: __FFTSAC
behavior: Address accessor: word-aligns a caller-supplied pointer (bclr #0 on its low byte) and stores the 16-bit value passed at (8,A6) into that address (A4).

name: __FFTSC
behavior: Computes a statistic over a trace/FFT buffer: errors if $b0e6>0, else fetches buffer+count via $32c22, counts and sums the samples exceeding threshold $b080, and returns the over-threshold average via jsr $61fe.

name: __FFTSTAC
behavior: 10-way enumerated dispatch: parses the keyword against a 10-entry offset table at $20f0e (jsr $862), each case pushing the arg and calling $20ea0 with a distinct bit-selector (0x000/0x800/0x100/…).

name: __FFTVDI
behavior: Sets the 2-bit FFT-mode field in RAM state word $bc64 to 10 (masks 0x3FFF, ORs 0x8000), clears $9b26, then calls the FFT redraw routine $561e8.

name: __GGTSWSW
behavior: DLP macro that sets up adjacent-channel-power (ACP) sweep parameters — defining the CHANNEL SPACING active function (ACPSP, default 25 kHz) and channel-bandwidth (ACPBW) when they are unset.

name: __GTCLPAR
behavior: DLP macro: if the FFT-stop flag __FFTSTF==1 it copies FFTSTOP into MF (marker/measurement frequency), then terminates with NV.

name: __GTCLRP
behavior: Runs a short DLP snippet 'KH '% AM|ON' (invokes classic command KH with a literal string); the fragment's exact meaning is unclear from the (possibly truncated) source.

name: __GTCLUP
behavior: DLP macro that runs DLPINIT then DLPTERM then NV — initializes and immediately terminates the downloadable-program state (cleanup/reset).

name: __GTCRBW
behavior: Conditional DLP macro keyed on the ANNOT (annotation) flag: if ANNOT==0 it clears __N,0 / __A,0 and runs EM, else if __N==0 it runs __FFTAI and conditionally __FFTCD — configuring FFT annotation/display state.

name: __GTCST
behavior: DLP macro that VRD (variable-read/restores) a series of saved __CZ* state variables (__CZBLEDS, __CZDET, __CZSP, __CZSS, __CZLG, __CZRB, __CZVB…), restoring the channel/measurement state set.

name: __GTCVBW
dlp_source: KEYCMD39,%IF(LG);IF(ACTVF(LG));HD;AMSG/LIN Scale can not be used for this meas.
behavior: Trampoline running a DLP macro that (re)defines the measurement's softkeys: KEYCMD39 is the SCALE LOG/LIN toggle that blocks LIN with error "LIN Scale can not be used for this meas.", KEYCMD74 is the SWEEP CONT/SGL toggle (ACPCONTM/ACPSNGLM keyed on MSBIT(9,10)), plus KEYDEF8041/8044. It configures the ACP measurement's scale and sweep-mode soft keys.

name: __GTDADJ
behavior: Trampoline whose DLP macro draws the adjacent-channel boundary bars: zeroes DA, conditionally sets pen from MSBIT(18,10), then does pen-up/pen-down vertical strokes at graticule columns __CZJCA-1 and __CZJCB-1 (channel-A/B edge indices) between rows 1 and 50. It paints the ACP channel-limit marker lines.

name: __GTDMKRF
behavior: Trampoline; the DLP macro refreshes the ACP density/PSD annotation (returns early if ANNOT==0): writes "CSP" (=ACPSP span) and "CBW" (=ACPBW channel BW) labels via __ACPANF, then displays channel power (DSPLYA CHPWR) and power-spectral-density (DSPLYPSD CHPSD) at fixed pen positions. It paints the density-marker result text.

name: __GTDMKRSTF
behavior: Trampoline whose DLP macro recomputes the averaged density-graph trace: sets __K=__CZBWTE, calls __ACPBWC, __W=__CZBNFDU, applies TRC-8000 offset then PAVGGRAPH,TRC,TRA,__CZBWTE,__W (power-average TRC into TRA) and clears the density marker (DRTYMK CLR,C). It restores/rebuilds the ACP average-graph state.

name: __GTEXIT
behavior: Trampoline; despite the name it paints the ACP results annotation (returns if ANNOT==0): "CSP"/"CBW" span/BW labels via __ACPANF, then " Pwr:" (DSPLYA ACPPWRTX), " Low:" (ACPLOWER dB) and " Up: " (ACPUPPER dB) — the adjacent-channel lower/upper power results block, with a compare of ACPLOWER vs ACPUPPER controlling blanking.

name: __GTGCTL
behavior: Trampoline whose DLP macro integrates adjacent-channel power: clamps integration indices __J/__K into [1,401] for the lower channel (__CZILA..__CZILB), runs __ACPBWC/__ACPPI to get ACPLOWER=__R-ACPPWRTX, repeats for the upper channel (__CZIUA..__CZIUB) to get ACPUPPER, then MXM ACPMAX. It computes the lower/upper ACP ratios relative to carrier.

name: __GTGDRV
behavior: Trampoline; the DLP macro is pure variable declaration/init for the window/gate driver: VARDEF __WN_ACT=0, __WN_IDO=-1, __WN_IDA=-1, __WN_VAR_1..5=0, then NV. It initialises the DLP window-management state variables.

name: __GTGSCLF
behavior: Trampoline whose DLP macro, when HAVE(GATE), variable-declares/reads the full gated-sweep state set (__GGTENTR, __GGTIN, __GGTVB, __GGTRB, __GGTSTM, __GGTRE, __GGTPWID, __GGTPRI, gate delay __GGTTMPD=GD, gate length __GGTTMPL=GL, __GGTRCTL=1) and then calls __GTMAKEVAR/__GTMAKEREM/__GGTSWSW/__GTSWDEF/__GTDMKRF/__GTLMKRF to rebuild gate menus and markers. It performs full gated-sweep variable/menu initialisation.

name: __GTGSCLSTF
behavior: Trampoline; the short DLP macro is a gate on/off state restore — IF(HAVE(GATE)) then IF(GSTAT(0)) GATE ON else GATE OFF. It re-applies the saved gate enable state from status bit GSTAT(0).

name: __GTGTOFF
behavior: Trampoline whose DLP macro executes KH /SWEEP|DELAY/, ACTVF __GTSWDE,0 — sets the SWEEP DELAY softkey's active/highlight flag via __GTSWDE. It reconfigures/turns off the sweep-delay (gate) soft key.

name: __GTGTON
behavior: Trampoline; the DLP macro sets the GATE CTL EDGE/LVL softkey based on gate status: IF(GSTAT(2)) KEYLBL 544,/GATE CTL|EDGE LVL/ else KH /GATE CTL|EDGE LVL/,0,GSTAT(1). It updates the gate-control soft key label/highlight for edge-vs-level triggering.

name: __GTGTRI
behavior: Trampoline whose DLP macro toggles the FFT measurement state: if __FFTA!=0 it clears __FFTA, saves FFTSTAT into __FFTSTF and sets __FFTA=1; else if (__FFTDIF==0 && FFTSTAT!=0) it zeroes FFTSTAT. It enables/disables the FFT (gated) processing state.

name: __GTINITVAR
behavior: Trampoline; despite the name the DLP macro drives a SIGNAL-CLIPPED overload annotation: sets pen to (5,190), and IF(1==__O) writes TEXT 'SIGNAL CLIPPED' with __A=1, else writes blanks to erase it with __A=0. It shows/clears the ADC-overload warning based on flag __O.

name: __GTINP
behavior: Trampoline whose DLP macro acquires and shows the ACP trace: __ACPSUD (setup), TRC-8000 offset, VIEW TRC, marker M1, __ACPCG (compute graph), NV. It performs the ACP input/acquire-and-display step.

name: __GTKSW
behavior: Trampoline; the DLP macro snapshots the current instrument settings into __CZ* shadow variables: __CZBLEDS=MSFIELD(8,15,16), __CZDET=DET, __CZSP=SP, __CZSS=SS, __CZLG=LG, __CZAT=AT, __CZRB=RB, __CZVB=VB, __CZST=ST. It saves detector/span/scale/atten/RBW/VBW/sweep-time state before the measurement changes them.

name: __GTLADJ
behavior: Trampoline whose DLP macro sets up the Occupied-Bandwidth measurement: __ACPSUD/__M5/__ACPSUM, WINITM 17/18/19,0 (init measurement windows), __ACPICALC, __OBWANLBL label, defines KEYCMD1288 as the % POWER key (OBWPCT), then __ACPSKA. It configures OBW windows, softkeys and labels.

name: __GTLMKRF
behavior: Trampoline; the DLP macro computes the occupied-bandwidth result: MOV OBWBW, PWRBW TRA, OBWPCT (bandwidth holding OBWPCT% of trace power), derives band edges OBWLOWER/OBWUPPER from marker fields MSFIELD(41)/MSFIELD(38) and per-point span __CZSPTE=SP/400, center error OBWFERR, then integrates power (__ACPPI→OBWPWR) and calls __OBWANRES. It calculates the OBW frequency edges and power.

name: __GTLMKRSTF
behavior: Trampoline whose DLP macro paints the OBW result annotation (returns if ANNOT==0): "(OBWPCT%)", "CSP" span, " OBW: " (OBWBW), " ùFc: " (OBWFERR center-freq error) via __ACPANF, and " Pwr:" (DSPLYA OBWPWR). It renders the occupied-bandwidth results text block.

name: __GTMAA
behavior: DLP trampoline (pushes len=115 src @062a0a, calls scheduler $d18.w) that initializes the Peak-Zoom scratch registers: sets DLP local variables __I..__P all to 10, __S=0, __T=0, __U=24, and __X=1.

name: __GTMAB
behavior: Trampoline running a Peak-Zoom keypress guard: IF(__PZKP==0){__PZKP=1;}PKZOOM; ELSE MOV PKZOOM,PKZOOM; i.e. on first press it sets the flag and runs PKZOOM, otherwise it re-echoes the PKZOOM active-function value.

name: __GTMAC
behavior: Trampoline that defines the PKZOOM active function when unset (ACTDEF PKZOOM,'FINAL SPAN',1E6,ABSHZ,...) with a 1 MHz default and an embedded __PZEXE branch gated on __PZADIF, then displays variables __PZADIF/__PZKP/PKZMOK via VRD.

name: __GTMAD
behavior: Trampoline for the 827-byte Peak-Zoom acquisition engine: TS/MKPK HI/__PZGETFRA, compares marker freq/amp against limits __A/__N and ref-level RL, iteratively lowers RL (MKRL) and re-sweeps, narrows span (SP/4) and recenters (CF/MKCF/__PZZOOM/__PZCHKIT), and reports 'Signal not found' when the PEAKS count __K==0.

name: __GTMAE
behavior: Trampoline continuing Peak-Zoom final narrowing: repeats MKRL/TS until MKA<=RL, goes CONTS with MKTRACK ON to track the peak, clamps span to 350 kHz, applies 8596-specific handling above 2 GHz, and ends in marker noise/signal-search modes (MKN, MKSS).

name: __GTMAF
dlp_source: ONCMD ST;ONCMD ANNOT;DISPOSE ONDELAY;DISPOSE ONEOS;MOV DA,__D;WINITM -1,1;IF (0!
behavior: Trampoline for Auto-FFT teardown: DISPOSE of ONDELAY/ONEOS and softkeys 61/67/297/131/8044/8041, restores DET/ANNOT/DRTYMK, blanks TRC/TRB, and zeroes all FFT state vars (FFTPCTAMR, __FFTSTF, __FFTA, __FFTDIF, FFTPCTAM, FFTSTAT, FFTCLIP, FFTSTOP).

name: __GTMAG
behavior: Trampoline that installs the Auto-FFT softkey menu: runs __FFTPAMK, then KEYDEFs key 131 (ANALOG+ ON/OFF -> __FFAPC), 61/67 (MARKER->MID SCRN -> FFTMM), 8044 (__FFSSHKC) and 8041 (__FFMUHKC).

name: __GTMAH
behavior: Trampoline that redraws the FFT graticule/annotation: toggles GRAT off/on when __M==1, clears window items (WINITM 7..10) and text via PUPA/TEXT blanks, and when annotation is on draws the 'FFT START 0 Hz' / 'FFT STOP' labels via PA/TEXT.

name: __GTMAI
behavior: Trampoline for one-time Auto-FFT init: IF(0==__FFTDIF){__FFTDEFS; DLPINIT __FFTEXIT; __FFTDIF=1;} — runs the FFT variable definitions, registers the __FFTEXIT handler, and sets the 'defined' flag so it only runs once.

name: __GTMAJ
behavior: Trampoline defining the 'MARKER / AUTO FFT' softkey header via KH, made conditionally active by the guard IF((1==__M)&&(1==__FFTDIF)).

name: __GTMAK
behavior: Short Auto-FFT activation trampoline: runs FFT video-display-init __FFTVDI, sets flag __M=1, then runs the FFT auto-compute macro __FFTAC.

name: __GTMAKECOM
behavior: Trampoline that blanks trace C (BLANK TRC), applies a FLATTOP window to it (TWNDOW TRC,FLATTOP), and stores the windowed trace sum into __T (MOV __T,SUM TRC) — a windowed power-sum computation.

name: __GTMAKEREM
behavior: Trampoline dispatching on the gate flag __GTPFLG: +1 -> __GTWID (gate width), -1 -> __GTPRIZ; a small gate-menu remake selector.

name: __GTMAKEVAR
behavior: Trampoline for the core single Auto-FFT computation: __FFTMI, sets trace states (S2/A1/A2) per MSBIT(9,*) status bits, TRDSP TRA OFF, TS, FFT TRB,TRA,TRC, VIEW TRB, conditional marker setup (MKACTV/MKTRACE/MKREAD FFT) gated on MSFIELD(37,*), registers ONEOS'__FFTCO;', and sets __FFTSTF=1 / FFTSTAT.

name: __GTMAKWINA
behavior: Trampoline defining softkey KEYCMD 1289: toggles the ACP graph-marker flag (IF(ACPMK>0){ACPMK=-1;}ELSE{ACPMK=1;}) and redefines the 'GRPH MKR ON OFF' softkey label with its on/off state.

name: __GTMAKWINB
behavior: Trampoline for 846-byte ACP channel-window geometry: computes span-per-bin __CZSPTE=SP/400, half-bandwidth-in-bins __CZIHBS, center-span-in-bins __CZICS, and the integer trace-bin boundaries __CZILA/ILB/ICA/ICB/IUA/IUB (channel A) plus __CZJ* (channel B) clamped to [1,401], and the channel bin-width __CZBWTE.

name: __GTMAO
behavior: Trampoline that sets reference level RL from marker amplitude MKA: MPY RL,MKA,1.059 when AUNITS==3, MPY by 1.122 when AUNITS==4 (voltage/power unit scaling), else ADD RL,MKA,.5 — the Peak-Zoom marker-to-ref-level step.

name: __GTMAP
behavior: Trampoline for the continuous Auto-FFT recompute path (companion to __GTMAKEVAR): __FFTMI, selects trace states A1/A2/A3/S2 and TRDSP per MSBIT(9,*) bits, registers ONEOS'__FFTCO;', either recomputes (FFT TRB,TRA,TRC; VIEW TRB) or just TS depending on __FFTSTF, updates markers (MKTRACE/MKREAD FFT), and sets __FFTSTF=1 / FFTSTAT.

name: __GTMNA
dlp_source: IF(MN==202); MENU 0; HD; ENDIF; IF(__WN_ACT); HD; ZMKCP -1,__WN_IDA; MOV __A,ZMK
behavior: Trampoline (pushes ROM DLP source 0x60504, calls scheduler $d18) that tears down the zoom-marker window: if in MENU 202 returns to MENU 0, and if a window is active (__WN_ACT) it disables/copies the zoom marker (ZMKCP/ZMKACT/ZMK OFF), re-inits the window (WININIT), disposes DLP object 8049 and clears __WN_ACT.

name: __GTMNB
behavior: Trampoline running DLP source 0x606A4 that updates the zoom window: queries the active window (WINACTIVE?), temporarily turns off video averaging (VAVG OFF), finds the next zoom-marker peak (ZMKPK NL), runs the pan/zoom sub __WN_P_ZOOM, then restores VAVG ON.

name: __GTMND
behavior: Trampoline running DLP source 0x60952 — the TOI (third-order-intercept) run dispatcher: if the personality is enabled (__SOENBL) and MODE==0 (spectrum) it runs the TOI measurement __TOIRUN when TOI is set, else re-inits the DLP (DLPINIT/DLPTERM); in any other mode it warns (WRNM).

name: __GTMNE
behavior: Trampoline running DLP source 0x60A5C that performs the TOI peak-find: PEAKS on trace __TRC locates the two fundamentals and two IM3 products, sorts them by position (__E..__H), validates count/spacing/excursion into status __T, then converts the four amplitudes (CTA), picks lin/log units, and calls __TOIDISP.

name: __GTMNF
behavior: Trampoline running DLP source 0x60D28 that computes the third-order intercept value: takes LOG of the four amplitudes __A-__D, forms two intercept estimates __Q/__R, stores the smaller as TOIR, EXPs it back to linear and applies lin/log scaling (__TOLNSCL/__TOLGSCL).

name: __GTMNH
behavior: Trampoline running DLP source 0x60E76 that converts the four TOI trace-point amplitudes __TRA[__F/__G/__E/__H] from raw trace units into screen dB values (formula (__TRA-8000+800*LG)/(4*LG)), storing them to __B/__C/__A/__D.

name: __GTMNI
behavior: Trampoline running DLP source 0x60F74 that lays out the on-screen TOI annotation: sets the display attribute (DA), blanks old text lines, re-enables the graticule (GRAT ON) and positions the pen (PA) to write the TOI result labels.

name: __GTMNJ
behavior: Trampoline running DLP source 0x613DE — the TOI annotation toggle: if ANNOT is on it redraws the TOI display (__TOIDISP), otherwise clears the display (CLRDSP) and redraws the graticule if GRAT is enabled.

name: __GTMNK
behavior: Trampoline running DLP source 0x61484 — the N-dB-down bandwidth run dispatcher: if the personality is enabled (__SOENBL) it runs the measurement __NDBRUN when NDBPNT is set, else re-inits the DLP (DLPINIT/DLPTERM).

name: __GTMNL
behavior: Trampoline running DLP source 0x6157A that performs the N-dB-down measurement body: PEAKS on trace __TRB, sets status __T (no-signal/warn), selects lin/log scaling (__NDLNSCL/__NDLGSCL), flags if bandwidth points hit the trace edges, then calls __NDBDISP.

name: __GTMNM
behavior: Trampoline running DLP source 0x617C6 that builds the N-dB threshold trace: from the __TRB peak it computes the (NDB-MKPX) threshold offset, builds a rectangular threshold trace and MXMs it against __TRA, finds the two crossing positions (PKPOS via MIRROR) and computes NDBPNTR as the N-dB bandwidth in frequency-span units.

name: __GTMNN
behavior: Trampoline running DLP source 0x6198E that lays out the on-screen N-dB-down annotation: sets the display attribute (DA), blanks old text lines, re-enables the graticule and positions the pen (PA) to write the N-dB bandwidth result labels.

name: __GTMNO
behavior: Trampoline running DLP source 0x61E08 — the N-dB annotation toggle (mirror of __GTMNJ): if ANNOT is on it redraws the N-dB display (__NDBDISP), otherwise clears the display and redraws the graticule if GRAT is on.

name: __GTMNQ
behavior: Trampoline running DLP source 0x61EB4 — the NDB parameter entry/clamp: forces NDB negative, clamps it between -1 and -80 dB (MIN/MXM), stores __NDBS, and if a measurement is running re-measures (__NDBMEAS) and enables the appropriate trace views (VIEW TRA/TRB/TRC) per the MSBIT status bits.

name: __GTMNS
behavior: Trampoline running DLP source 0x6200E — the %AM-depth measurement setup: DLPINIT __AMTERM, sets __AMRFLG, ensures MENU 50, runs __SOONRUN, hooks ANNOT to __AMANOT and installs __AMMEAS as the end-of-sweep (ONEOS) handler so it re-measures each sweep.

name: __GTMNV
behavior: Trampoline running DLP source 0x621F6 that computes percent AM depth: forms the two sideband-to-carrier ratios __Q/__R (200*__TRA[sideband]/__TRA[carrier]), stores the larger as the result PCTAMR, and scales the three amplitudes by /40.

name: __GTMNX
behavior: Trampoline running DLP source 0x623F4 — the %AM display dispatch: if ANNOT is on it draws the signal-found AM result (__AMSIG) when status __T==0, otherwise the no-signal message (__AMNOSIG).

name: __GTMNY
