behavior: Trampoline running DLP source 0x62628 that draws the %AM result/error text: blanks old text lines, writes the ' AM:' label, and on error status writes 'Require 3 signals > PEAK EXCURSION above THRESHOLD' (__T==1) or 'Signals do not fit expected % AM pattern' (__T==2), setting PCTAMR=-100 on failure.

name: __GTMNZ
behavior: DLP trampoline (pushes token 0x40, calls scheduler $d18) running the macro `DISPOSE ONEOS;ONCMD ANNOT, ;{__AMRFLG=0;};{PCTAMR=-100;};CLRDSP;NV`. It exits/cleans up a measurement mode: disposes the one-shot end-of-sweep hook, disarms the ANNOT annotation command, clears the AM-marker flag __AMRFLG and PCTAMR=-100, then clears the display (CLRDSP).

name: __GTNEXT
behavior: DLP trampoline running the ACP (adjacent-channel-power) draw macro: `__ACPANLBL;IF(GRAT);GRAT0;GRAT1;ELSE GRAT0;ENDIF;IF(ACPGR==-1);{ACPMK=-1;};BLANK TRC;__ACPSKA;__ACPC;ELSE __ACPSKB;ACPGRAPH;ENDIF`. It repaints the ACP annotation labels and graticule, and either blanks trace TRC / draws the ACP skirt-A view (__ACPSKA/__ACPC) or the ACP graph view (__ACPSKB/ACPGRAPH) depending on ACPGR.

name: __GTONHK
behavior: DLP trampoline running `IF ACPSP,LT,1E3;MOV ACPSP,1E3;ENDIF;IF ACPSP,GT,9999E5;MOV ACPSP,9999E5;ENDIF;__ACPAUTOB;{SS=ACPSP;};UDEFPV ACPSP,ACPSP;NV`. It clamps the ACP channel spacing/span variable ACPSP to [1 kHz, 999.9 MHz], runs ACP auto-setup __ACPAUTOB, copies ACPSP into span SS, and re-declares ACPSP as a user parameter.

name: __GTPRGT
behavior: DLP trampoline for the ACP measurement-with-graph execution: runs __ACPCC (compute) and returns on ACPERR, saves attenuation state (__CZAT=MSBIT(8,9)), drops ref level RL by 30 dB, takes a sweep (TS), does trace math on TRA/TRB (MXM/MIN/SUB/ADD, VIEW TRC), restores RL and AT AUTO, then draws the ACP graph (__ACPCG or __ACPAC/__ACPANRES) and clears the delta marker.

name: __GTPRIZ
behavior: DLP trampoline running an FFT-mode setup macro: if __FFTA!=0 it saves marker freq MF into __F, clears __FFTA, derives FFTSTOP from sweep-time ST (DIV ST,200,FFTSTOP and back), restores MF and runs __FFSTPA when __N!=0; otherwise it zeroes FFTSTOP when __FFTDIF==0 and FFTSTOP!=0. Manages the FFT stop-frequency / FFT-active state variables.

name: __GTPTRK
behavior: DLP trampoline running `MOV __GGTMN,242;HD;__GTMAP;__GTWINTRK;NV`. It selects gate menu number __GGTMN=242, holds the display (HD), then runs the gate-map (__GTMAP) and gate-window-track (__GTWINTRK) routines to enter the gated-sweep window-tracking view.

name: __GTREDG
behavior: DLP trampoline for the gated/FFT SIGNAL ID procedure: requires SINGLE or CONTINUS FFT active (else prompts the user), positions the marker (MKTRACE TRB/MKREAD FFT/MKACTV with an AMSG prompt), then adjusts FFTSTOP and increments sweep-time ST in 20us steps, validates the readout (emits 'INVALID SIGNAL ID READOUT' when MF is near FFTSTOP), and toggles the graticule via ONDELAY. Implements gated-FFT signal identification.

name: __GTREMA
behavior: DLP trampoline running `IF(__GTCPLR==0);MOV GDRVRBW,1;ELSE;MOV GDRVRBW,0;ENDIF`. It sets the gate-drive RES-BW coupling flag GDRVRBW from the gate RBW-coupling state __GTCPLR (coupled=1, manual=0).

name: __GTREMB
behavior: DLP trampoline running `IF(__GTCPLV==0);MOV GDRVVBW,1;ELSE;MOV GDRVVBW,0;ENDIF`. Identical to __GTREMA but for video bandwidth: it sets the gate-drive VID-BW coupling flag GDRVVBW from the gate VBW-coupling state __GTCPLV.

name: __GTREMC
behavior: DLP trampoline that sets label Y-positions __A/__B by orientation __Z, then if pulse period __GGTPRI>0 sets the gate-drive sweep-time coupling flag GDRVST from __GTCPLS, else draws the 'PULSE PERIOD (PRI) MUST BE ENTERED... See Pulse Param menu' text prompt at position-dependent PA coordinates. Handles gate sweep-time coupling / missing-PRI warning.

name: __GTREMD
behavior: DLP trampoline running `MOV __GGTMN,242;__GTWINTRK`. It selects gate menu __GGTMN=242 and runs the gate-window-track routine __GTWINTRK (a shorter variant of __GTPTRK without the HD/__GTMAP steps).

name: __GTREME
behavior: DLP trampoline running `IF(GSTAT(1));KB;ELSE;KH /GATE|DELAY/,ACTVF __GTDMKR,0;ENDIF;NV`. If gate status GSTAT(1) is set it beeps/backs out (KB); otherwise it highlights the 'GATE DELAY' softkey (KH) and activates the gate-delay marker function __GTDMKR.

name: __GTREMF
behavior: DLP trampoline running `IF(GSTAT(1));KB;ELSE;KH /GATE|LENGTH/,ACTVF __GTLMKR,0;ENDIF`. Same pattern as __GTREME but for gate length: highlights the 'GATE LENGTH' softkey and activates the gate-length marker function __GTLMKR.

name: __GTREMG
behavior: DLP trampoline running `KH /GATE|ON  OFF/,0,GSTAT 0;NV`. It highlights the 'GATE ON OFF' softkey and sets the time-gate status GSTAT to 0 (gate off).

name: __GTREMH
behavior: DLP trampoline running `IF (__GTTMF==1);DISPOSE ONEOS;MKOFF;{__GTTMF=0;};IF (__Z==1);ELSE;CLRBOX 1,211,300,221,0;ENDIF;ENDIF`. If the gate time-marker flag __GTTMF is set, it disposes the one-shot end-of-sweep hook, turns markers off (MKOFF), clears the flag, and erases the 'GATE TRIG TO MKR' text box.

name: __GTREMI
behavior: DLP trampoline running a block of VRD variable-default reads that initialize the gate personality's local variables __A..__Z (e.g. __E=DA, __F=DA, __L=6, __O=2, __P=398, __Q=ST, __S=ST, __V=-1, __W=GD, __X=-1, __Y=-1, __Z=0). It is the gate-measurement variable-initialization/reset routine.

name: __GTREMJ
behavior: DLP trampoline that toggles the gate time-marker flag __GTTMF: when turning it on it runs window track/swap (__GTWINTRK/__GTWINSWAP), draws 'GATE TRIG TO MKR:' with the DA value, sets and updates a marker on trace TRA (__GTUPMK); when turning off it disposes the hook, clears the box, re-tracks the window and turns markers off. Implements the GATE TRIG TO MKR toggle/display.

name: __GTREMK
behavior: DLP trampoline running the gate reset-all macro: clears a display box (CLRBOX by __Z), zeroes the gate globals __GGTRE/__GGTPWID/__GGTPRI/__GTTTM and all gate-drive coupling variables (GDRVREFE/PWID/PRI/ST/RBW/VBW), then runs __GTSHPP. It clears/resets the entire gated-sweep measurement state.

name: __GTREML
behavior: DLP trampoline (token 0x2b at src 0x6a914) that reconfigures the gated/pulse-measurement drive: sets __GGTRE=__GTTTM (ABS), clears the on-screen box (CLRBOX 1,211,300,221), HD/MKOFF ALL/DISPOSE ONEOS, rehooks ONCMD ST/GD to __GTUNCS/__GTPRGT, sets menu 246, runs __GTSHPP, and loads the gate-drive registers GDRVST/GDRVRBW/GDRVREFE/GDRVPWID/GDRVPRI from the __GGT* pulse params.

name: __GTREMM
behavior: DLP trampoline (src 0x6ac7e) implementing the interactive 'measure the PRI' helper: menu 248, __GTPTRK peak-track, prints TEXT prompts ('Position the delta marker…the pulse or pattern period (PRI)…Press DONE'), then computes PRI from the delta marker via __T=(__GTTTM-__GTSWDE)/(ST/401) with MKN/MKP/MKTRACE TRA/MKD and stores __GGTPRI=MKF on end-of-sweep.

name: __GTRUNX
behavior: DLP trampoline (src 0x67f64) that draws the ACP channel-boundary tick lines: sets DA=0 and does a series of pen PU/PD (PA) strokes at the channel-zone edge coordinates __CZJLA/__CZJLB (lower), __CZJCA/__CZJCB (center), __CZJUA/__CZJUB (upper) to render the vertical channel limit markers on the graticule.

name: __GTSHPP
behavior: DLP trampoline (src 0x659e4) whose entire source is 'FFTSNGLS;' — it issues the FFT single-sweep command.

name: __GTSPGD
behavior: DLP trampoline (src 0x673c6) that sets up the ACP/CHP/OBW power-graph display: returns if __CZSU==0, sets ACPMK=-1, A1/B4/BLANK TRC, then per mode __M installs the graph/graticule and the appropriate end-of-sweep handler (__M1→__ACPC, __M3→GRAT/label, __M4→CHP __CHPC, __M5→OBW __OBWC).

name: __GTSWADJ
behavior: DLP trampoline (src 0x68542) that adjusts the ACP sweep marker/on-marker-update handler: if ACPMK>0 it activates marker 1 on TRC and (mode<4) installs an ONMKRU that computes ACPMKA=MKA+ACPPWRTX and displays it (DSPLYA) with a save/restore of TRC[201] and delta MKD=ACPSP; else disposes ONMKRU and redraws the graticule.

name: __GTSWDEF
behavior: DLP trampoline (src 0x68688) defining the CHP (channel-power) measurement: __ACPSUD, mode __M4, __ACPSUM setup, __ACPICALC integrate, __CHPANTIC/__CHPANLBL/__CHPERR annotation+error, and defines softkey 1288 (KEYCMD1288) as a PWRGRAPH ON/OFF toggle on CHPGR.

name: __GTSWDESTF
behavior: DLP trampoline (src 0x6799c) that recomputes ACP integration when parameters change: if ACPBW/ACPSP/SP/RB/ACPPAR differ from cached __F/__G/__H/__C/__B it re-runs __ACPICALC/annotation/graticule/labels/error and re-caches them, then clamps the integration indices __J,__K to [1..401] (from __CZILA/__CZIUB) and runs __ACPBWC/__ACPPI, storing ACPPWRTX=__R.

name: __GTTDRW
behavior: DLP trampoline (token 0x2b, src 0x6595a) whose source is 'IF (1==__FFTSTF);DIV FFTSTOP,MF,0.50;ENDIF;' — when the FFT-stop flag is set it sets FFTSTOP = MF/0.50 (marker-freq scaled).

name: __GTTRKNXT
behavior: DLP trampoline (src 0x699e4) whose source is 'MKOFF ALL;DISPOSE ONEOS;__GTGSCL;' — turns off all markers, disposes the end-of-sweep handler, and runs __GTGSCL (gated-scale) to advance to the next track step.

name: __GTTTMKR
behavior: DLP trampoline (src 0x64b06) that sets the FFT stop bin from sweep time: if __FFTSTF==1 it computes FFTSTOP=400/(ST*2) (bracketed by __FFTA=0/1), optionally __FFSTPA when __N!=0, and queries FFTSTOP; otherwise HD and errors with AMSG 'You must activate SINGLE FFT…'.

name: __GTUNCB
behavior: DLP trampoline (src 0x676ba) that recomputes/annotates ACP: '__ACPCC;IF(ACPERR)RETURN;IF(ACPGR>0)__ACPCG ELSE __ACPAC;{DA=__E;};__ACPANRES;' — runs the ACP channel calc, returns on error, then either the graph (__ACPCG) or numeric-annotate (__ACPAC) path and restores annotation.

name: __GTUNCS
behavior: DLP trampoline (src 0x6751e) that performs ACP setup in mode 1: __ACPSUD, __M1, __ACPSUM, __ACPICALC, __ACPANTIC/__ACPANLBL/__ACPERR annotation+error, and defines softkey 1288 as an ACPGRAPH ON/OFF toggle on ACPGR.

name: __GTUNCV
behavior: DLP trampoline (src 0x67750) identical to __GTUNCS but with mode __M3: runs ACP setup (__ACPSUD/__ACPSUM/__ACPICALC/annotation/error) and the same ACPGRAPH softkey-1288 toggle, i.e. the mode-3 ACP measurement setup.

name: __GTUPCP
behavior: DLP trampoline (src 0x65f1a) that initializes the ACP measurement DLP once (if __CZSU==0): DLPINIT with done-handler __ACPDONE, __ACPSUK setup, hooks ONCMD ANNOT→__ACPANNOT, PA, and marks setup-done via __CZSU1.

name: __GTUPMK
behavior: DLP trampoline (src 0x64dee) whose source is 'IF (1==__FFTDIF);DLPINIT;DLPTERM;ENDIF;' — when the FFT-diff flag is set it re-initializes and terminates the DLP (DLPINIT/DLPTERM) to update the marker/FFT state.

name: __GTVCST
behavior: DLP trampoline (token 0xd1, src 0x6bb44) that sets sweep time from the pulse PRI: computes __T=401*__GGTPRI, and if >100 draws the warning TEXT 'PRI TOO LONG. TRACE DROPOUTS MAY OCCUR', then sets sweep time ST=__T, rehooks ONCMD ST→__GTUNCS, and caches __GTTEMS=ST.

name: __GTVDFS
behavior: DLP trampoline (token 0x6e, src 0x66596) that restores the ACP video/default measurement state: T1, TRPRST trace-preset, DET0 detector, ST AUTO, forces log scale (LG10, or LG13 in mode __M3), sets step size SS=ACPSP, and runs __ACPAUTOB auto-bandwidth.

name: __GTWID
behavior: DLP macro: if graphics vars __V and __N are both non-zero it positions the pen (PA=__U;PA=__V), draws TEXT(' ') and sets DA=__B, then computes __J=PEAKS(__TRA,TRB,...) — i.e. it peak-scans the trace arrays and lays down a graticule/window text marker.

name: __GTWINSET
behavior: DLP macro that resets measurement-window state: TRPRST (trace preset), DISPOSE ONMKRU (drop the marker-update handler), then IF(ACPPAR) runs __ACPRCLP;LIMITEST0 else DISPOSE ONEOS — configures the ACP/window measurement and tears down its end-of-sweep/marker service routines.

name: __GTWINSWAP
behavior: Short DLP macro 'MOV __GGTMN,245;HD;__GTWINTRK;NV': sets the graphics-menu variable __GGTMN to 245, holds, invokes __GTWINTRK to re-track the active window, and updates the display.

name: __GTWINTRK
behavior: DLP macro 'KH /T WINDOW|SWP TIME/,ACTVF __GTGSCL,0;NV': installs the 'T WINDOW / SWP TIME' softkey label and makes __GTGSCL the active function (with initial value 0), then updates the display.

name: __GTZOOM
behavior: DLP macro that clamps the occupied-bandwidth-percent variable OBWPCT into the range [1, 99.99] (MOV OBWPCT,1 / MOV OBWPCT,99.99) before an update — the zoom/percent guard for the OBW window measurement.

name: __MN
behavior: Menu-select handler: tests bit 12 of RAM flag $b1e0 and, if the current menu id at $b1fe equals 0x12 (its arg_type), calls the low-memory menu/A7-API dispatch routine at $4d8.w; otherwise returns without action.

name: __NDBACT
behavior: Queries whether the N-dB measurement is active/ready: calls status sub $5eca2, tests cal-valid bit0 of $94e1 and bit13 of $befa, reads sweep-status MMIO $FFF300 and tests bit 11 (sweep-complete), and returns a 0/1/2 state code in the A6 frame.

name: __NDBANOT
behavior: Draws the N-dB measurement annotations: in a loop it computes screen Y=0xC8-idx*0xA, sets the pen via jsr $154, draws marker/line primitives (jsr $5dc2/$75a), loads a per-entry longword from the table at (A4*4 - $5FBA) and formats/prints the value with jsr $62b2/$6016.

name: __NDBDISP
behavior: Accessor that loads and returns the 32-bit RAM variable at $a99a (an NDB display-state/pointer word); the resolved handler is a clean link/move.l $a99a/unlk/rts getter, not a screen-drawing action.

name: __NDBMEAS
behavior: Parses the command's keyword argument string (byte via pointer in D0/A4) through the token-lookup helper jsr $7978.w using table id 0x18, then switches on the result via the 16-entry jump table at 0x39b10 (mis-disassembled as ori.b #$XX,D3) to select an NDB measurement submode.

name: __NDBNOSIG
behavior: Configures the NDB 'no-signal' parameter block: divides the incoming value by 10 up to 3 times to derive a scale exponent, packs that exponent into the low 2 bits of $b0f0.w, and stores two parsed values (via jsr $7978.w) into $b0f2.w and $b0f4.w.

name: __NDBRUN
behavior: Starts/re-inits the NDB measurement run: masks interrupts (ori #$700,SR) and initializes measurement buffers in cal-scratch RAM at 0x2FC136 (offsets +$CA and +$7E2, up to 0x2FFFFF) via helper $399FA, then reads the pointer at $a7d6 and status word $bb52.

name: __NDBSIG
behavior: Constant-return stub: the resolved handler at 0x3f8a8 is 'moveq #1,D0; rts', i.e. it always returns 1 (signal-present = true).

name: __NDBTERM
behavior: Renders the NDB measurement result/terminal text: branches on state word $9fb4 (>=2 vs <2) to pick a ROM string (0x4a3b6 / 0x4a3ca), then positions the pen (jsr $154) and prints the fixed ROM strings at 0x4a3da/0x4a3f0 (jsr $100).

name: __NDBUPDATE
behavior: Updates an NDB display/measurement parameter by forwarding to helper $f092 with a mode tuple chosen from the arg at ($a,A6): value<2 -> f092(0,arg,val), ==2 -> f092(2,0,val), ==3 -> f092(2,1,val).

name: __NDLGSCL
behavior: Sets the NDB measurement to LOG scale: inspects the argument string bytes (first char / a space 0x20 at offset 1) and calls scale-setter $3adac with the ROM parameter table 0x3d108 (or falls through to $3afc8) — the log-scale counterpart of __NDLNSCL.

name: __NDLNSCL
behavior: Sets the NDB measurement to LINEAR scale by calling scale-setter $3adac with argument 0; its companion sub $3afc8 parses a count and copies bytes into the scale buffers at $a360/$a370.

name: __OBWANERR
behavior: Resets the occupied-bandwidth annotation/separator buffer byte $acca to 0 and calls redraw routine $26282; sibling routines build $acca by mapping arg chars B/C/S to separators 0x20/0x2c/0x3b (space/comma/semicolon).

name: __OBWANLBL
behavior: Native handler at 0x4F2DE: takes the OBW active-trace selector from D0 (or from RAM $9EA6.w when D0==0xFFFF), validates it is in 0..3, then indexes a per-trace word table (base displacement -0x616A, i.e. high-RAM near 0xFF9E96) by idx*4, reads the entry, and returns its absolute value in D0. Reads an OBW parameter value for the selected trace; no MMIO/DAC access.

name: __OBWANRES
behavior: Native handler at 0x24B6A is a two-instruction body that clears RAM word $9FD0.w (an OBW state/result cell) and returns. A reset of one OBW status word only.

name: __OBWC
behavior: Native handler at 0x4FFD6: parses its argument (jsr $6B8 arg-fetch, $6E8/$6090 numeric parse) to a trace index into $9EA6.w (or uses the stored active trace), validates 0..3, checks per-trace flag bit7 at table -0x61AE, then matches the argument keyword bytes 'N' then 'L'/'R' (0x4E,0x4C/0x52). Parses an OBW 'NL'/'NR' keyword argument gated on the trace-enabled flag.

name: __OBWM
behavior: Native handler at 0x4F8B4: resolves the OBW trace selector ($9EA6.w or parsed arg), and unless the arg is a '?' query, parses a numeric value pair via helper $4E8AE (returns two longwords in D2/D3). Sets/reads an OBW measurement value pair for the selected trace.

name: __OBWPCT
behavior: Native handler at 0x223B6 computes an OBW percent/count value: helper $223A2 reads config bit4 of RAM $B213.w to select constant 0x28(40) vs 3, then computes 2000-x, shifts left 8 and masks 0xFFF into D0; an adjacent nested leaf writes nibble-packed data to the A7 analog I/O bus (0xFFF728 select / 0xFFF72A data). The exact percent semantics and the f728 helper's caller are inferred, not resolved.

name: __OBWS
behavior: Native handler at 0x4ED26: unless the arg is a '?' query, parses a number ($6E8/$6090) validated to the range -1..3 and stores it as the OBW active-trace selector in $9EA6.w, then returns $9EA6.w. This is the OBW source/trace select register used across the OBW family.

name: __PKAM
behavior: Trampoline running DLP source that registers ONCMD hooks for the START (ST) and SPAN (SP) commands: if the marker-value equals the reference it preserves start into __T when span==0 else zeros span, and sets start (ST) from __GTGSCL. A marker/span (auto-center / zero-span) soft-key macro.

name: __PKAMT
behavior: Trampoline whose DLP source, when FFT mode is active (FFTSTAT), copies FFTSTOP into marker-freq MF, otherwise sets MF=FB and FB=MKF. A marker-to-frequency handoff that branches on FFT vs normal sweep state.

name: __PKBMD
behavior: Trampoline: if menu-state __MN[18] equals the marker-active flag it turns markers off (MKOFF), else it invokes __PKAM and __PKMAF; ends with NV (no re-verify). A marker band/mode toggle soft-key.

name: __PKBPD
behavior: Trampoline that reads menu-state bits/fields (MSBIT(55,13), MSFIELD(26,..)/(27,..)) and, when span==0, adjusts __X and computes __Y from a state field offset by 4000 and scaled by FMGAIN. A band-power / marker field-computation macro.

name: __PKCR
behavior: Trampoline: when marker-value equals reference it runs __GTMAP and HD, sets __V=__Y, runs window-track __GTWINTRK, and hooks the GL (graph limit-line) command to load __GGTTMPL. A cursor/graph-window redraw and GL command-hook macro.

name: __PKCRE
behavior: Trampoline that zeros graph control __GGTRCTL and, if user-routine GDRVUTIL is undefined, defines it via ACTDEF bound to &__GTREMA and stores it. Sets up a graphics drive-utility user function.

name: __PKCUG
behavior: Trampoline: stores the peak result PKRES[__N]=__X, converts point index __X to a frequency __F=(FA+SP*(__X-1)/400)/1E6 MHz (start-freq FA plus span SP over 400 trace points), displays it with DSPLY and updates the cursor amplitude via CTA. A peak/cursor readout-to-frequency macro.

name: __PKDF
behavior: Trampoline that disposes the on-marker-update handler (DISPOSE ONMKRU), runs __PKIF1, zeros the marker table (MOV MKTBL,0), runs __PKIF0 and __PKDTW. A marker-table clear / delete-function soft-key.

name: __PKDFA
behavior: Trampoline: if a frequency counter is present (HAVE(CNT)) and the marker frequency-counter is active (ACTVF(MKFCR)) and the menu bit MSBIT(32,9) is set, it turns the counter off (MKFCR0, HD), otherwise re-asserts MKFCR. A marker frequency-counter enable/disable soft-key.

name: __PKDMD
behavior: Trampoline that toggles marker pause: if MKPAUSE is active it clears it (MKPAUSE0) else sets it (MKPAUSE1), ending with NV. A marker-pause toggle soft-key.

name: __PKDMT
behavior: Trampoline that loads menu field __MN[22]=MSFIELD(37,15,2) and, when it is zero, emits a soft-key label 'MK TRACE|...' via KH. A marker-trace menu/soft-key-label setup macro.

name: __PKDPD
behavior: Trampoline running a FOR loop over menu fields (__MN[19]=37..48) reading MSFIELD(__MN[19],4,5) to locate the active soft-key/menu slot. A menu-scan / soft-key dispatch macro.

name: __PKDPT
behavior: DLP trampoline (pushes source id, jsr $d18 scheduler): if not already in the __PKIF guarded state, it enters it (__PKIF1) and clamps the peak/delta-line mode variable PKDLMODE to the range [-1,1] via MXM/MIN, then leaves the guard (__PKIF0). Toggles/limits a peak delta-line display mode.

name: __PKDT
behavior: DLP trampoline: if not in the __PKIF guard, when there is no peak table (PKTBL) it does a bare DLPINIT;DLPTERM bracket, else it DLPINITs with __PKPTO, turns all markers off (MKOFF ALL) and moves __TRB.. — i.e. it (re)builds or tears down the peak-table display context.

name: __PKDTW
behavior: DLP trampoline that writes the display text label " Inactive " (padded) via TEXT, terminated by NV. Paints the 'Inactive' annotation for a peak/gate field.

name: __PKENA
behavior: DLP trampoline: sets DA=0, clears a box region (CLRBOX -40,-1,400,60) then draws a rectangle outline with the vector pen (PU/PA/PD to the corner coordinates). Draws the enable/annotation border box on the display.

name: __PKEND
behavior: DLP trampoline: displays numeric value __A with format 8.2 (offset by marker-table flag MKTBL) and appends units text — 'dBDL' when in marker delta-line mode (MKTBL&&MKDLMODE), else a __C-conditional unit. Formats a marker amplitude readout with units.

name: __PKENF
behavior: Unresolved (handler_pc=0, not reached via the dispatch tables). By name and by its only caller __PKENT ('MOV __F,__A;__PKENF'), it is most likely the peak/entry frequency-readout companion to the amplitude routine __PKEND, formatting/displaying the __F frequency register — but this is inferred, not confirmed from disassembly.

name: __PKENT
behavior: DLP trampoline: copies the accumulator __A into the frequency register __F (MOV __F,__A) then invokes __PKENF to render it (NV terminator). Loads and displays the peak-marker/entry frequency value.

name: __PKFMB
behavior: DLP trampoline: computes menu-state var __MN[21] = MSFIELD(37,11,4)%5 (forcing 1 when span=0 and result 0), then guarded on __MN[21] defines a softkey via KH,/M... — a peak/marker menu-field builder driven by a measurement status field.

name: __PKFNA
behavior: DLP trampoline: EM (erase/empty), disables annotation (ANNOT0), DISPOSE 8049 (frees a display object), re-inits the window (WININIT), re-enables annotation (ANNOT1) and registers ONCMD hooks for ANNOT and WINZOOM. Reinitializes the display window plus its annotation/zoom command handlers.

name: __PKIP
behavior: DLP trampoline (the factory power-up personality routine whose corruption caused the Opt-027 reboot loop): if __GGTMN==0 it registers an active-function via ACTDEF __GGTMN with a 500 STEP and an action block that sets MN=__GGTMN. Installs the gate-menu active function.

name: __PKITG
behavior: DLP trampoline: conditional units/label helper — when __C is 19 or 22 and __N==2 it emits a TEXT label (source truncated). Selects a marker readout unit-text string based on the __C/__N mode variables.

name: __PKITW
behavior: DLP trampoline: tests measurement-status bits MSBIT(9,x) and prints the active-trace letter — TEXT('A') if bit7/bit0 set, else TEXT('B') if bit8/bit3, etc. Renders which trace (A/B/...) is active from the status word.

name: __PKMA
behavior: DLP trampoline: clears the __Z flag, turns the graticule off (GRAT OFF), sets trace-mode __T to -1 or -2 depending on the gate time-mode flag __GTTMF, then continues into __GT... — sets up a gated-measurement display mode (graticule off, trace-select).

name: __PKMAF
behavior: DLP trampoline: MOV GDRVRBW,0 (clears the gate-drive resolution-bandwidth coupling variable) terminated by NV. Zeroes the RBW gate-drive coupling state.

name: __PKMAO
behavior: DLP trampoline: an empty DLPINIT;DLPTERM bracket (NV) — an init/terminate pair with no body, effectively flushing/resetting the DLP display context.

name: __PKMBD
behavior: DLP trampoline: guarded on menu var __MN[18]==1 it defines a softkey via KH,/SELECT|... (source truncated). Builds a 'SELECT' softkey for a marker-band/menu field.

name: __PKMD
behavior: DLP trampoline: registers a set of ONCMD command-intercept handlers — ST→__GTUNCS, and GD/GL/GATE→__GTPRGT (plus more, truncated). Installs the gate/sweep command handlers for the gated-measurement personality.

name: __PKMFA
behavior: DLP trampoline: when gate-control __GGTRCTL==1, sets the coupling variable __GTCPLV to 0 or 1 depending on GDRVVBW (video-BW gate drive) then calls __GTCVBW. Manages VBW coupling in gated-measurement mode.

name: __PKMFB
behavior: 16-byte DLP trampoline (jsr $d18 scheduler) that runs the DLP source `__GTWINSWAP;NV` — invokes the gate-utility window-swap subroutine, toggling which gate-utility display window is active, then returns.

name: __PKMKMN
behavior: DLP trampoline running the gate-utility init/banner script: `IF(__GTVRDS==0)` then pen-up (PU), position-absolute (PA 8,170/8,160) and draw the `INITIALIZING GATE UTILITY.` text on the graticule the first time the utility is drawn.

name: __PKMM
behavior: DLP trampoline `__PKAM;M3;IF(__MN[18]==2);__MN[18]1;IF(MN==9);MN9;ENDIF;ENDIF;NV` — calls sub __PKAM, sets marker mode M3, and normalizes gate-utility menu state (resets menu var __MN[18] from 2 to 1 and re-selects menu 9 when active).

name: __PKMMT
behavior: DLP trampoline `IF(HAVE(CNT));IF(MSBIT(8,13));MC0;ELSE;MC1;ENDIF;ELSE;WRNO;ENDIF;` — if the frequency-counter option is present, toggles marker-count (MC0/MC1) based on status bit (8,13); otherwise issues WRNO (feature-not-available warning).

name: __PKMN
behavior: DLP trampoline building the gate-utility window layout: `WINOPEN __X,0,120,400,90` opens window __X at x=0,y=120 sized 400x90, `WINITM -1` clears items, and successive `WINANNOT` calls define the annotation fields.

name: __PKMRE
behavior: DLP trampoline `IF(__GTLMKR==0);ACTDEF __GTLMKR,/GATE LENGTH/,__GGTTMPL,SEC,&__GTLMKRSTF;&;ENDIF` — lazily defines the GATE LENGTH active function (units SEC, step routine __GTLMKRSTF) the first time it is needed.

name: __PKMTA
behavior: DLP trampoline for gate-utility layout/coupling: `IF(__GGTPRI>0){__GTCPLS=1;}` sets the coupling flag, then branches on window vars __V/__X and flag __Z to set on-screen coordinate temporaries __A/__B (e.g. 180,170).

name: __PKMTE
behavior: DLP trampoline `__GTMAP;__GTDMKR;` — sequentially calls the gate-map subroutine and the gate delay-marker subroutine to redraw the gate map and delay marker.

name: __PKMTO
behavior: DLP trampoline `__PKAM;__PKMAF;` — chains two other gate-utility package subroutines (__PKAM then __PKMAF); the exact effect lives in those subs, but this record just sequences them.

name: __PKNAU
behavior: Unresolved DLP-internal routine (handler_pc=0, dispatch tables did not resolve it); by naming it is another `__PK…` subroutine of the factory GATE UTILITY DLP, but no disassembly or source is available to confirm its action.

name: __PKNMR
behavior: DLP trampoline `IF __GTDMKR,LT,1E-6;MOV __GTDMKR,1E-6;...IF __GTDMKR,GT,65E-3;MOV __GTDMKR,65E-3` — clamps the gate delay-marker value __GTDMKR to the valid range 1 us .. 65 ms.

name: __PKNMT
behavior: DLP trampoline `IF(__GTSWDE==0);ACTDEF __GTSWDE,/SWEEP DELAY/,GD,SEC,&__GTSWDESTF;&;ENDIF;NV` — lazily defines the SWEEP DELAY active function (units SEC, step routine __GTSWDESTF) the first time it is needed.

name: __PKNSP
behavior: Unresolved DLP-internal routine (handler_pc=0, not resolved via dispatch tables); by naming pattern a `__PK…` subroutine of the GATE UTILITY DLP, but no handler or source is available to confirm behavior.

name: __PKOCA
behavior: Unresolved DLP-internal routine (handler_pc=0, dispatch tables did not resolve it); a `__PK…`-family gate-utility subroutine by name only, with no disassembly or DLP source to verify.

name: __PKPDL
behavior: DLP trampoline `M2;MKTYPE PSN;E1;M3;MKMIN;NV` — configures markers for the gate measurement: select marker 2, set marker type to position (PSN), E1, select marker 3, then marker-to-minimum (MKMIN).

name: __PKPK
behavior: DLP trampoline `IF (__V==__Y);__GTWINSWAP;ENDIF;NV` — conditionally swaps the gate-utility window (calls __GTWINSWAP) when window variable __V equals __Y.

name: __PKPME
behavior: DLP trampoline `IF(__Z==1);CLRBOX 1,1,399,199,0;ENDIF;IF (__V==__X);WINACTIVE __X;{__GTSPF=0;}` — optionally clears the full display box, then activates window __X and clears the sweep-pending flag __GTSPF.

name: __PKPS
behavior: DLP trampoline `MOV __GTDUM,ZMK OFF,__X;{__GTGDIS=1;};NV` — moves the ZMK-OFF value of window __X into the dummy var __GTDUM and sets the gate-display-enable flag __GTGDIS=1.

name: __PKPTA
behavior: DLP trampoline running a peak/plot-menu macro that clamps menu variable __MN[18] to the range 1..4, calls __PKFMB, and (when an FFT measurement is active and __MN[19] is clear) moves a marker value.

name: __PKPTO
behavior: DLP trampoline whose short macro '__PKAM;MN12;E1;' invokes __PKAM, selects softkey menu 12, then executes function key E1.

name: __PKSM
behavior: DLP trampoline: if the sweep-time active-function variable __GTGSCL is 0 it ACTDEFs it as active function 'SWEEP TIME' with a 10E-3 SEC default (and STF step handler), i.e. sets up the sweep-time menu entry.

name: __PKSME
behavior: DLP trampoline graph/window macro: when __V==__X it maps the graph (__GTMAP), holds, sets __V=__Y, runs window tracking (__GTWINTRK) and installs ONCMD GL handlers tying GL to __GGTTMPL.

name: __PKTC
behavior: DLP trampoline: if graph control __GGTRCTL==1, toggles the gate drive by calling __GTGTOFF when GDRVGT==0 else __GTGTON — gate on/off control for the gated-sweep graph.

name: __PKTL
behavior: DLP trampoline: if graph control __GGTRCTL==1, copies GDRVPRI into __GGTPRI, takes its absolute value (ABS), and UDEFPVs GDRVPRI — updating the graph's lower/priority drive parameter.

name: __PKTM
behavior: DLP trampoline: if graph control __GGTRCTL==1, conditionally swaps the window (__GTWINSWAP when __V==__Y), then moves GDRVSWP (sweep drive) into __GTGSCL and UDEFPVs it — updating the graph sweep-time drive.

name: __PKTP
behavior: DLP trampoline: if graph control __GGTRCTL==1, copies GDRVREFE (ref-level drive) into __GGTRE, takes ABS, and UDEFPVs GDRVREFE — updating the graph top/reference drive parameter.

name: __PZCHKIT
behavior: Native predicate at 0x209D4: btst #15,$FFADC4 and if set returns -1 in D0, otherwise returns the word at $FFB0C8 — a status/check accessor reading the $ADC4 flag word.

name: __PZEXE
behavior: Native handler at 0x31724: calls low-mem service $136 with D0=-3, and if the returned word != 0xFFFF it sets ($FFBAF8=0xFF) or clears ($FFBAF8=0) the byte flag $FFBAF8 based on bit0 of its input argument.

name: __PZGETFRA
behavior: Native handler at 0x20AE6: loads table/string pointer 0x20DC6 into D0 and tail-calls the shared '?'-query parameter processor at 0x209E6 (which checks for the '?' query char, tests $FFB0A0 bit11 and emits from either 0x20DC2 or 0x20DC6).

name: __PZKEYEXE
behavior: Native handler at 0x2F4C0: a 0..3 subcommand dispatcher on D0 that sets/clears bit15 of the key-state register $FFB116 and bit4 of $FFBFF7, gated on hardware key/status reads via helpers $2F498/$5414/$54B8 — front-panel key execution state machine.

name: __PZKEYMNU
behavior: Native handler at 0x2FB18: programs the key-menu state — $FFB118=1, $FFB11A=0x1CCD/0x1CCC (per $FFBFF6 bit10), $FFB11C=7, key register $FFB116=0x603E/0xE03E, writes command 0xEC to keyboard/PIT port $FFF801, and sets timing/count cells $FFB102=1000, $FFB0FE=1, $FFB0FC=1.

name: __PZREMCMDS
behavior: Native handler at 0x544F4: copies the remote/interface state byte $FFB05D into $FFB05C and switch-dispatches on it to remote-command handlers ($544B0/$543D8), managing $FFBBBC and clearing bit5 of $FFBEFD — processes queued remote (HP-IB) commands.

name: __PZZOOM
behavior: Native handler at 0x54FA2: reads a pair of longword args at (A6+8), normalizes them via number-helper $609C, then uses bit-field extractor $69B4 (fields 0xE/0xF/0xC...) to assemble packed parameter values written back through $54EB2 — builds/programs a zoom-window parameter set.

name: __SOONIP
behavior: Native handler at 0x17C9A: rejects the query form ('?' at arg[1]), copies its keyword argument into a local buffer, looks it up to an index via parser $6090, range-checks 0..0x31 (49), and dispatches through $17A64 — a keyword sub-command parser/dispatcher.

name: __SOONRUN
behavior: Native handler at 0x3A74C: initializes a count at 0xFFAD, then loops decrementing it (while > -1000 and while helper $32BDA(D0,0x2000) stays positive) before calling $3A0E2 and $3A642 with the arg-string pointer at (A6+8) — a range/search-and-emit loop whose exact subsystem is not identifiable from this fragment.

name: __SOTRACE
behavior: Native handler at 0x4E7BC: stores its 32-bit argument into state cell $FFBB12, loads the mode word $FFB076, and calls display/state-update helper $1AF8 — sets a trace-related state variable and triggers a redraw.

name: __TOIACT
behavior: Handler at 0x179FE tail-calls fcn.179E2, which clears bit 11 of state word $b212.w, tests $ba6b.w bit 2, and conditionally ORs 0x56 into the display-mode/scale status word $b1f8.w before jsr $19c. Activates the TOI (third-order-intercept) measurement mode.

name: __TOIANOT
behavior: Handler at 0x5F276 pushes 0xFFFF plus its D0 arg and calls fcn.5E9C4, which clears/updates the TOI measurement state word $94d6.w (in the 0x948e measurement-state block) according to the arg (0/-1/other). Sets the TOI annotation state.

name: __TOIDISP
behavior: Handler at 0x3F84A takes arg (8,A6), calls fcn.3D83E (which when $b234.w==5 runs HP-IB/display output routines $64f0/$62e4/$62b2), then $5dc2/$ad8. Formats and emits a TOI display/result value via the output path; exact quantity is name-inferred.

name: __TOIMEAS
behavior: Handler at 0x17FB4 is a jump-table state machine: jsr $154 range-checks an index, indexes a 7-entry PC-relative table at 0x17FBC (offsets 0x62..0xa6) and jsr $100 to the selected step, also invoking DLP sources at 0x193b0/0x193b6. Drives the sequential TOI measurement.

name: __TOINOSIG
behavior: Handler at 0x5F28C calls fcn.5ECA2, parses a numeric arg via jsr $2f2, then clamps the value at (8,A6) to a maximum of 0x3E80 (16000) and a minimum of 1. A parameter-setter for the TOI no-signal amplitude threshold.

name: __TOIRUN
behavior: Handler at 0x6FE6 clears run/marker byte $bf01.w, reads mode byte $9b20.w (sign-extended), and on the taken path sets flag $beff.w = 0xFF. Starts/continues the TOI measurement run.

name: __TOISIG
behavior: Handler at 0x40384 builds a flags byte in a local by testing hardware/status bits: $b1f7.w bit4, $b0a1.w bit0, $b1e0.w bit8, and $b1f9.w bits1/2/4 (qualified by $b073.w bits 2/3/5). Aggregates signal-present status into a returned bitfield.

name: __TOITERM
behavior: Handler at 0x5ECC4 calls fcn.5ECBC, clears measurement-state words $94e0.w and $94d6.w, then via fcn.5ECA2/5E33A conditionally finalizes. Terminates the TOI measurement and resets its state.

name: __TOLGSCL
behavior: Handler at 0xBA7C clamps two args each to 0..15, stores them to $ba74.w/$ba75.w, packs them into a word 0x7000|(a<<4)|b and sends it via fcn.C30A. Sets the log-scale (two 4-bit fields) display/scale parameter.

name: __TOLGUNITS
behavior: Handler at 0x3EDE4 matches an argument against a 7-entry table at 0x3EDEC (offsets 0x44..0x64) via fcn.39762, then parses two numeric values through jsr $2f2 at (8,A6)/(-4,A6). Selects the log-amplitude units and their operands.

name: __TOLNSCL
behavior: Handler at 0x3972E is a 3-instruction accessor: link, move.w $b20a.w,D0, unlk/rts — it returns the current linear-scale value held in RAM word $b20a.w.

name: __TOLNUNITS
behavior: Handler at 0x7CD6 masks bits 0x30 of status word $b1f6.w and returns 1 (seq) iff both bits are set, else 0. A boolean query for whether linear-units mode is selected.

name: __VCOM
behavior: Unresolved (handler_pc=0): a DLP-internal startup 'global routine' dispatched through the DLP record region (slot 1145, record-offset 0x479 → recPtr 0x71AFB), token 0x158→0x5FBDE per docs. It is the one startup global with a real body, setting up the common/video DLP environment; not resolvable via the C dispatch tables.

name: __WN_EXIT
behavior: Handler at 0x29BE4 reads window-state byte $abfa.w and returns 1 (seq) iff it equals 5, else 0. A boolean predicate testing the window 'exit' condition.

name: __WN_ON
behavior: Handler at 0x4C530 parses an argument list via jsr $2f2, then while a count at (-e,A6) > 0 iterates computing element addresses and calling fcn.4BDE6 per element. Enables/configures windows from the parsed list.

name: __WN_PK_NL
behavior: Handler at 0x37D70 walks a window peak/marker table using cursor $a5d8.w vs count $a5d6.w and base pointer $a5dc.w (bounds $a5e4/$a5e8), searching via fcn.3174C/$439a. Finds the next peak entry to the left in the window peak array.

name: __WN_PK_NR
behavior: Handler at 0x57E86 parses 3 coordinate params plus a keyword via fcn.57B80, then dispatches on the keyword's first letter — 'T'/'t' selects plane mask 0x5555 (text/graticule plane), 'A'/'a' selects 0xAAAA (trace plane) — and calls draw routine jsr $39a. Paints into a window using a plane-select code (name suggests peak-next-right but the disasm is a plane-select paint).

name: __WN_P_ZOOM
behavior: Handler at 0x37FC4 calls fcn.37ED6 to compute a value, ORs it with command tag 0xB000, and emits it via jsr $646; neighbouring code maintains a window flag bitmap at (-0x5a34,A4) with dirty flag $a5d5.w. Issues the window point-zoom command.

name: __WN_VARDEF
behavior: DLP-internal ('__'-prefixed) command whose handler did not resolve through the dispatch tables (pc=0); by name it appears to be a WiNdow VARiable DEFinition — declaring/binding a named variable within the DLP window/graphics context — but no disassembly confirms this.

name: or
behavior: Native handler at 0x434e6 that LINKs a frame, validates a 0x168-byte CalRAM block via helper $61ec, then word-copies calibration/state tables from CalRAM scratch (0x2fc016, 0x2fcb42, 0x2fc91a, 0x2fca1c) into low working-RAM buffers ($9eb6, $a01e, $a096, $a198); it is a state/table restore from cal RAM, not a bitwise-OR operation.
